# BetterTouchTool Documentation

[Skip to main content](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#__docusaurus_skipToContent_fallback)

On this page

This document describes the JSON structure for creating floating menus in BetterTouchTool.

**NOTE** Some text is replaced with special characters to reduce the size of this document for LLM usage: © = BTT $ = BTTMenu § = BTTMenuItem

Basic Structure[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#basic-structure "Direct link to Basic Structure")

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A floating menu JSON is an array containing menu objects. Each menu can contain multiple menu items via the `§s` array.

    [  {    "©TriggerType": 767,    "©TriggerClass": "©TriggerTypeFloatingMenu",    "©Enabled": 1,    "©TriggerName": "Floating Menu: Menu Name",    "$Name": "Menu Name",    "$Config": {},    "§s": [],    "$Availability": 0  }]

Menu Item Types (`©TriggerType`)[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#menu-item-types-triggertype "Direct link to menu-item-types-triggertype")

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **767** - Menu (top level)
*   **773** - Standard Item (button with actions)
*   **774** - Submenu (contains nested items)
*   **775** - Slider (range configurable; reports its exact value to its actions)
*   **776** - Text Field (value queryable via scripts)
*   **777** - Back Button (for submenus)
*   **778** - WebView (displays HTML from §Text)
*   **800** - Trackpad widget
*   **801** - Row Breaker
*   **802** - Column Breaker
*   **810** - Text Area (value queryable via scripts)
*   **811** - Floating Menu Reference
*   **860** - Knob Item (rotary knob; rotates via scroll / click-drag on screen, maps to a physical encoder on a macro pad)

Menu Properties[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#menu-properties "Direct link to Menu Properties")

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Core Properties[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#core-properties "Direct link to Core Properties")

*   `©TriggerType`: 767 for menu
*   `©UUID`: Unique identifier
*   `©Enabled`: 1 to enable
*   `$Name`: Display name
*   `$Config`: Configuration object
*   `§s`: Array of menu items
*   `$Availability`: 0=everywhere, 1=mac, 2=ios, 3=iphone, 4=ipad, 5=embedded, 6=macro pad only (menu is hidden from normal on-screen display and only drives its bound macro pad; the pad binding itself is set via `$MacroPadSerial` and works with any availability — see the Macro Pad section)
*   `©Order`: Display order
*   `©LastUpdatedAt`: Timestamp
*   `©AppBundleIdentifier`: App-specific bundle ID
*   `©AppName`: App-specific name

### Item Properties[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#item-properties "Direct link to Item Properties")

*   `©TriggerType`: Item type (773, 774, etc.)
*   `©TriggerParentUUID`: Parent menu's UUID
*   `©UUID`: Unique identifier
*   `©Enabled`: 1 to enable
*   `©TriggerName`: Display name
*   `$Config`: Item configuration
*   `§Actions`: Array of actions

Menu Configuration (`$Config`)[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#menu-configuration-config "Direct link to menu-configuration-config")

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Positioning & Layout[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#positioning--layout "Direct link to Positioning & Layout")

*   `$PositioningType`: 0=freeMove, 1=fixedPosition, 2=menubarStatusItem
*   `$PositionRelativeTo`: 0=focusedWindow, 1=screenWithMouse, 3=focusedScreen, 7=mousePosition, 8=builtin, 11=notch, 12=focusedMenubar, 19=screenWithDock, 20=greenWindowButton, 21=hoveredFloatingMenuItem, 22=specificFloatingMenu, 23=dock
*   `$AnchorMenu`: 0=topLeft, 1=topRight, 2=bottomLeft, 3=bottomRight, 4=center, 5=topEdgeCenter, 6=rightEdgeCenter, 7=bottomEdgeCenter, 8=leftEdgeCenter
*   `$AnchorRelation`: Same values as $AnchorMenu
*   `$OffsetX`/`$OffsetY`: Position offset (positive X = right, negative X = left; positive Y = up, negative Y = down)
*   `$OffsetXUnit`/`$OffsetYUnit`: 0=absolute, 1=menu%, 2=referenceFrame%
*   `$PositionDynamicVariable`: Variable for dynamic positioning
*   `$ScreenUUID`: Specific screen UUID

### Layout Direction[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#layout-direction "Direct link to Layout Direction")

*   `$LayoutDirection`: 0=fillRow, 1=fillColumn, 2=fillRowFixed, 3=fillColumnFixed, 4=absoluteScrollable, 5=absoluteFixed, 6=verticalOneColumn, 7=horizontalOneRow, 8=circular
*   `$HorizontalAlignment`: 0=leading, 1=center, 2=trailing
*   `$VerticalAlignment`: 0=top, 1=center, 2=bottom
*   `$VerticalSpacing`: Vertical spacing (pixels)
*   `$HorizontalSpacing`: Horizontal spacing (pixels)

### Size[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#size "Direct link to Size")

*   `$SizingBehavior`: 0=zero, 1=fixed, 2=variable, 3=content
*   `$FrameWidth`/`$FrameHeight`: Menu dimensions
*   `$FrameMaxWidth`/`$FrameMaxHeight`: Maximum dimensions
*   `$FrameWidthVariable`/`$FrameHeightVariable`: Variable names for dynamic sizing

### Hover Behavior[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#hover-behavior "Direct link to Hover Behavior")

*   `$ResizeOnHover`: 1 to enable hover resize
*   `$SizingBehaviorHover`: Hover sizing mode
*   `$FrameWidthHovered`/`$FrameHeightHovered`: Hovered dimensions
*   `$FrameWidthVariableHover`/`$FrameHeightVariableHover`: Hover variables
*   `$HoverKeepExpanded`: 1 to stay expanded
*   `$GoBackToNonHoveredSizeAfter`: Seconds to collapse
*   `$HoverExpansionDirection`: 0=rightUp, 1=leftUp, 2=rightDown, 3=leftDown, 4=leftRightDown, 5=leftRightUp, 6=upDownLeft, 7=upDownRight
*   `$HoverStartAnimationDuration`/`$HoverEndAnimationDuration`: Animation durations
*   `$HoverDelay`: Hover activation delay
*   `$HoverWhileMousePressed`: 1 to hover while dragging
*   `$StealKeyboardFocusOnHover`: 1 to steal keyboard focus when hovering the menu
*   `§AnimateHover`: 1 to animate hover

### Window Properties[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#window-properties "Direct link to Window Properties")

*   `$WindowLevel`: 3=floating, 0=normal, 20=dock, 24=mainMenu, -1=custom
*   `$WindowLevelManual`: Custom level when $WindowLevel=-1
*   `$WindowResizable`: 1 to allow resizing
*   `$TitleBarStyle`: 0=noTitleBar, 1=standard, 2=overlayContent, 3=transparent
*   `$CloseButtonReleasesMemory`: 1 = the red title bar close button fully closes the menu and releases its content (including cached web views) from memory instead of only hiding it. Overrides `$KeepCached` and keep-active-in-background; the menu and its web content are recreated the next time it is shown. Only relevant while a title bar is shown (`$TitleBarStyle` != 0)
*   `$ClickThroughEmptyParts`: 1 to click through empty areas
*   `$ClickThroughEverywhere`: 1 to click through everywhere
*   `$ShowDockIconWhileVisible`: 1 to show dock icon
*   `$ShowOnLockScreen`: 1 to show on lock screen
*   `$StealKeyboardFocusOnShow`: 1 to steal focus

### Visibility[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#visibility "Direct link to Visibility")

*   `$Visibility`: 0=onLaunch, 1=viaAction, 2=viaActionRestoreOnAppActivation (app-specific menus only; remembers shown state and restores when app becomes active again)
*   `$OpacityActive`/`$OpacityInactive`: Opacity 0-1
*   `$AlwaysUseLightMode`: 1 to force light mode
*   `$KeepCached`: 1 to keep cached when hidden
*   `$AnimateShow`: 1 to animate appearance
*   `$AnimateShowDuration`: Animation duration
*   `$AnimateChanges`: 1 to animate property changes

### Visibility Conditions[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#visibility-conditions "Direct link to Visibility Conditions")

*   `$ShowIfWindowTitleIsNotEmpty`: 1 to check
*   `$ShowIfWindowTitleContains`: String to match
*   `$ShowIfAppNameContains`: String to match
*   `$ShowIfWindowTitleContainsNot`: String to exclude
*   `$ShowIfAppNameContainsNot`: String to exclude
*   `$ShowIfWindowLevelEqualsEnabled`: 1 to enable check
*   `$ShowIfWindowLevelEquals`: Window level value
*   `$ShowForWindowWithID`: Only show for specific window ID
*   `$DoNotShowInFullscreen`: 1 to hide in fullscreen
*   `$OnlyShowOnSpaces`: Comma-separated space numbers

### Interaction[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#interaction "Direct link to Interaction")

*   `$CloseOnOutsideClick`: 1 to close on outside click
*   `$CloseOnMoveMouseAway`: 1 to close when mouse leaves
*   `$CloseOnKeyboardInput`: 1 to close on keyboard
*   `$CloseAfterAction`: 1 to close after action
*   `$DisableDrag`: 1 to disable dragging
*   `$ContinuouslyFollowMouse`: 1 to make menu follow the mouse continuously
*   `$KeepLastHoveredItemSelectedOnMouseOut`: 1 to keep last hovered item selected when mouse leaves
*   `$AllowScrolling`: 1 to allow scrolling (default 1)
*   `§CloseOnClick`: 1 to close menu on item click (default 1)
*   `§ShowHoverEffect`: 1 to show hover effect (default 1)
*   `§ShowIcon`: 1 to show the item icon (default 1)
*   `§RepeatRate`: repeat-while-held — while the item is held down (on-screen press/touch or macro pad key), its standard actions refire every `§RepeatRate` seconds. 0/omitted = no repeat. While repeating is enabled, the item's long-press actions are disabled
*   `§RepeatDelay`: initial delay in seconds before the repeat starts (default 0.5)
*   Double click: an item can hold separate actions in the `©ActionCategoryDoubleClick` category (59). Assigning anything there delays that item's standard (single click) actions by the system double click interval — only then can a single click be told apart from the first half of a double click. Items without double click actions are unaffected and keep firing immediately

### Alternate Mode[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#alternate-mode "Direct link to Alternate Mode")

*   `$AlternateModeActive`: 1 to activate alternate mode
*   `$AlternateModeActiveVariable`: BTT variable name that controls alternate mode

### Merging[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#merging "Direct link to Merging")

*   `$MergeGlobalMenuItems`: 1 to merge items from global menu with same name

### Modifiers[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#modifiers "Direct link to Modifiers")

*   `§sUseModifierModes`: true if items use modifiers
*   `$ModifierMode`: -1=none, 0=showIfPressed, 1=showIfOthersPressed, 2=showIfNonePressed, 3=showAlways, 4=showIfPressedShowNonModified, 5=showIfAtLeast, 6=dontShowIfPressed
*   `$ModifierKeys`: Bitmask of modifier keys

### Scripting[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#scripting "Direct link to Scripting")

*   `§ScriptActive`: 1 to enable script
*   `$ScriptSettings`: Script configuration object
*   `$ValueChangedScriptSettings`: Script for value changes
*   `$ScriptRunOnMenuHover`: 1 to run on menu hover
*   `$ScriptRunOnItemHover`: 1 to run on item hover
*   `$ScriptAlwaysRunOnFirstLoad`: 1 to run on load
*   `$ScriptUpdateInterval`: Update interval in seconds
*   `$ScriptAlwaysRunOnAppear`: 1 to run on appear

### Script Configuration (`$ScriptSettings`)[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#script-configuration-scriptsettings "Direct link to script-configuration-scriptsettings")

*   `©ScriptType`: 0=appleScript, 1=jax, 2=scpt, 3=realJavaScript, 4=shortcut
*   `©AppleScriptString`: Script content
*   `©ScriptFunctionToCall`: Function name
*   `©ScriptShortcutName`: Shortcut name
*   `©ScriptLocation`: 0=inline, 1=preset, 2/3=external
*   `©ScriptExternalPath`: External script path
*   `©JavaScriptUseIsolatedContext`: true for isolated JS

### Item Properties[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#item-properties-1 "Direct link to Item Properties")

#### Visibility[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#visibility-1 "Direct link to Visibility")

*   `§Disabled`: 1 to disable
*   `§VisibleWhileActive`: 1 when menu hovered
*   `§VisibleWhileInactive`: 1 when not hovered
*   `§VisibleIfVariableIsTrue`: Variable name
*   `§VisibleIfVariableIsFalse`: Variable name
*   `§DisplayOrder`: Custom order value

#### Size & Position[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#size--position "Direct link to Size & Position")

*   `§MinWidth`/`§MaxWidth`: Width constraints
*   `§MinHeight`/`§MaxHeight`: Height constraints
*   `§PaddingLeft`/`Right`/`Top`/`Bottom`: Internal padding
*   `§MarginLeft`/`Right`/`Top`/`Bottom`: External margin
*   `§PositioningMode`: 1 for manual positioning
*   `§X`/`§Y`: Manual position
*   `§OffsetX`/`§OffsetY`: Position offset

#### Text[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#text "Direct link to Text")

*   `$AttributedText`: RTF-encoded text
*   `$AttributedTextDark`: Dark mode RTF text
*   `§Text`: Plain text/HTML (for webviews)
*   `$ElementIdentifier`: Scripting identifier
*   Item text supports variables in curly braces; `{item_identifier}` resolves to the item's `$ElementIdentifier` (standard items, submenus & back buttons only — sliders, knobs & widgets render text as-is). New items use it as default text so renaming the identifier updates the displayed text
*   `$ElementTooltip`: Tooltip text
*   `§ShowIdentifierAsTooltip`: 1=identifier, 2=tooltip
*   `$TextMinimumScaleFactor`: Min scale 0-1
*   `$TextOffsetX`/`$TextOffsetY`: Text offset
*   `§FontColor`/`§FontColorHover`: Font colors
*   `§FontColorDark`/`§FontColorHoverDark`: Dark mode font colors

#### Background[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#background "Direct link to Background")

*   `§BackgroundType`: 0=none, 1=data, 2=sfsymbol, 3=file, 4=color, 5=linearGradient, 6=radialGradient, 7=presetFile, 8=internal
*   `§BackgroundColor`/`§BackgroundColor2`/`§BackgroundColor3`/`§BackgroundColor4`: Gradient colors "R,G,B,A"
*   `§BackgroundColorHover`: Hover background
*   `§BackgroundImageData`: Base64 image data
*   `§BackgroundImagePresetPath`: Preset path
*   `§BlurredBackground`: 1 for blur effect
*   `§GlassEffect`: 1 for macOS Tahoe glass effect
*   Dark mode variants with `Dark` suffix (`§BackgroundTypeDark`, `§BackgroundColorDark`/`§BackgroundColor2Dark`/`§BackgroundColor3Dark`/`§BackgroundColor4Dark`, `§BackgroundColorHoverDark`, `§BackgroundImageDataDark`, `§BackgroundImagePresetPathDark`, `§BlurredBackgroundDark`, `§GlassEffectDark`)

#### Borders[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#borders "Direct link to Borders")

*   `§BorderWidth`: Border width
*   `§BorderColor`: Border color "R,G,B,A"
*   `§BorderColorHover`: Hover border color
*   `§BorderDashed`: 1 for dashed
*   `§CornerRadius`: Corner radius
*   `§CornerRadiusCorners`: 0=all, 1=left, 2=right, 3=top, 4=bottom, 5=topLeft, 6=topRight, 7=bottomRight, 8=bottomLeft
*   Dark mode variants with `Dark` suffix (`§BorderWidthDark`, `§BorderColorDark`, `§BorderColorHoverDark`, `§BorderDashedDark`, `§CornerRadiusDark`, `§CornerRadiusCornersDark`)

#### Shadow[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#shadow "Direct link to Shadow")

*   `§ShadowEnabled`: 1 to enable
*   `§ShadowColor`: Shadow color
*   `§ShadowColorHover`: Shadow color on hover
*   `§ShadowRadius`: Shadow radius
*   Dark mode variants with `Dark` suffix (`§ShadowEnabledDark`, `§ShadowColorDark`, `§ShadowColorHoverDark`, `§ShadowRadiusDark`)

#### Icons/Images[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#iconsimages "Direct link to Icons/Images")

*   `§IconType`: Same as §BackgroundType
*   `§IconPosition`: 0=left, 1=top legacy, 2=right, 3=bottom legacy, 4=center, 5=none, 6=top centered, 7=bottom centered (defaults to 0=left)
*   `§Image`: Base64 image data
*   `§IconPresetPath`: Preset icon path
*   `§ResizeImage`: 0=fit, 1=none, 2=fixed, 3=fitNew
*   `§ImageChangeColor`: 1 to tint with icon color
*   `§ImageWidth`: Image width
*   `§ImageHeight`: Image height
*   `§ImageOffsetX`/`Y`: Image offset
*   `§ImagePadding`: Image padding
*   Dark mode variants with `Dark` suffix (`§IconTypeDark`, `§IconPositionDark`, `§ImageDark`, `§IconPresetPathDark`, `§ResizeImageDark`, `§ImageChangeColorDark`, `§ImageWidthDark`, `§ImageHeightDark`, `§ImageOffsetXDark`/`YDark`, `§ImagePaddingDark`)
*   `$AutomaticallyOptimizeImages` (menu property, set in the `$Config` of a menu, `©TriggerType` 767): 1 = bitmap icons are drawn from compressed copies scaled to their displayed size (Retina included) instead of the full-resolution source, and a standalone menu export carries those smaller copies (embedded as `§Image*` with `§IconType*` 1, replacing the preset path). Only affects `§IconType*` 1 (data), 3 (file) and 7 (presetFile); SF symbols, colors and gradients are untouched, and the original images stay in the local configuration so the icons can be enlarged again later. Every item of the menu inherits the value; a nested menu (767) may override it with its own 0/1. The key is ignored on items (773, 774, ...). Default 0. Exports and the runtime copy repeat the resolved value in each item's `$Config` as a JSON boolean; `true`/`false` and `1`/`0` are both accepted on import

#### SF Symbols[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#sf-symbols "Direct link to SF Symbols")

*   `§SFSymbolName`: Symbol name
*   `§SFSymbolWeight`: Symbol weight
*   `§SFSymbolStyle`: 0=monochrome, 1=hierarchical, 2=palette, 3=multiColor
*   `§IconColor1`/`§IconColor2`/`§IconColor3`: Symbol colors (palette uses 2-3 colors, hierarchical uses 1)
*   `§IconColor1Hover`/`§IconColor2Hover`/`§IconColor3Hover`: Hover colors
*   Dark mode variants with `Dark` suffix (`§SFSymbolNameDark`, `§SFSymbolWeightDark`, `§SFSymbolStyleDark`, `§IconColor1Dark`/`§IconColor2Dark`/`§IconColor3Dark`, `§IconColor1HoverDark`/`§IconColor2HoverDark`/`§IconColor3HoverDark`)

#### WebView Properties[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#webview-properties "Direct link to WebView Properties")

*   `§WebViewPlain`: 1 for plain HTML
*   `§UserAgent`: Custom user agent
*   `§UserScript`: Script on load
*   `§UserScriptOnvisible`: Script on visible
*   `§WebViewFocusTextField`: 1 to auto-focus
*   `§WebViewFocusTextFieldWithID`: Field ID
*   `§KeepActiveInBackground`: 1 to keep active
*   `§SystemBrowserPrefix`: External URL prefixes
*   `§SystemBrowserPrefixOverrides`: Override prefixes
*   `§SystemBrowserClosesMenu`: 1 to close on external

#### Circular Layout[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#circular-layout "Direct link to Circular Layout")

*   `$HoverOnWholePizzaSlice`: 1 for whole wedge hover
*   `$HighlightPizzaSlice`: 1 to highlight wedge
*   `$PlaceFirstItemAtCenter`: 1 to center first item
*   `§PizzaSliceBackgroundColor`: Wedge background
*   `§PizzaSliceBorderColor`: Wedge border
*   `§PizzaSliceBorderWidth`: Border width
*   Dark mode variants with `Dark` suffix (`§PizzaSliceBackgroundColorDark`, `§PizzaSliceBorderColorDark`, `§PizzaSliceBorderWidthDark`)

#### Submenu Display (on submenu items, ©TriggerType 774)[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#submenu-display-on-submenu-items-triggertype-774 "Direct link to Submenu Display (on submenu items, ©TriggerType 774)")

*   `§SubmenuDisplayMode`: 0=drill-in, children replace the menu content (default); 1=fan-out, children expand as a concentric arc outside the main ring. Fan-out only applies to menus with `$LayoutDirection` 8 (circular); other layouts fall back to drill-in.
*   `§SubmenuOpenOn`: What opens a fan-out submenu: 0=click (default), 1=hover, 2=click & hover
*   `§SubmenuHoverOpenDelay`: Seconds the item must stay hovered before the fan opens (default 0.15)
*   `§SubmenuHoverCloseDelay`: Grace period in seconds after the pointer leaves the item slice/arc before the fan closes (default 0.25)
*   `§SubmenuRingGap`: Gap in px between the ring and the fan-out children (default 6)
*   `§SubmenuMaxArcSpan`: Maximum arc span in degrees; children shrink to fit (default 160)
*   `§SubmenuShowConnector`: 1 (default) draws a connector slice between the item and its children, styled via the item's pizza slice colors. Only shown when pizza slice highlighting is enabled (`$HighlightPizzaSlice` ≥ 1, an item-level value overrides the menu-level one) — the connector visually extends the slice highlight

#### Interaction[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#interaction-1 "Direct link to Interaction")

*   `§Focused`: 1 for initial focus
*   `§ScrollEnabled`: 1 to enable scroll
*   `§ScrollDelta`: Touch scroll delta
*   `§ScrollDeltaNormalMouse`: Mouse scroll delta

#### Folder Widget Properties[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#folder-widget-properties "Direct link to Folder Widget Properties")

*   `§Path`: Folder path to display (e.g. "/Applications/BetterTouchTool.app")

#### Widget Properties (General)[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#widget-properties-general "Direct link to Widget Properties (General)")

*   `$WidgetStringStringDictionary`: String dictionary
*   `$WidgetStringIntDictionary`: Integer dictionary
*   `$WidgetCustomPluginID`: Plugin bundle identifier for custom widgets

#### Now Playing Widget[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#now-playing-widget "Direct link to Now Playing Widget")

*   `$WidgetNowPlayingPauseBehavior`: 0=icon, 1=albumcover
*   `$WidgetNowPlayingHideCover`: 0=album cover, 1=app icon, 2=hidden
*   `$WidgetNowPlayingShowAlbum`: 0=hide, 1=show
*   `$WidgetNowPlayingHideWhenPaused`: 0=show, 1=show paused, 2=hide
*   `$WidgetNowPlayingHideWhenNoPlayer`: 0=show, 1=hide
*   `$WidgetNowPlayingLayout`: 0=horizontal, 1=vertical
*   `$WidgetNowPlayingShowProgress`: 0=hidden, 1=show progress bar
*   `$WidgetNowPlayingAllowedApps`: Comma-separated bundle IDs (empty=all)

#### Weather Widget[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#weather-widget "Direct link to Weather Widget")

*   `$WidgetWeatherUnit`: 0=Celsius, 1=Fahrenheit, 2=System
*   `$WidgetWeatherAutoLocation`: 0=manual, 1=auto (default)
*   `$WidgetWeatherLatLon`: "lat,lon" for manual location
*   `$WidgetWeatherLayout`: 0=variables mode, 1=rich SwiftUI
*   `$WidgetWeatherForecastDay`: -1=current, 0-7=forecast day
*   `$WidgetWeatherHideWhenNoData`: 0=show, 1=hide

#### Trackpad Widget[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#trackpad-widget "Direct link to Trackpad Widget")

*   `$WidgetTrackpadFingerMoveColor`: Finger move color
*   `$WidgetTrackpadFingerDragColor`: Finger drag color
*   `$WidgetTrackpadFingerScrollColor`: Finger scroll color
*   `$WidgetTrackpadEdgeScroll`: 1 to enable edge scroll
*   `$WidgetTrackpadEdgeRightClick`: 1 to enable edge right-click
*   `$WidgetTrackpadTwoFingerScroll`: 1 to enable two-finger scroll
*   `$WidgetTrackpadTwoFingerRightClick`: 1 to enable two-finger right-click
*   `$WidgetTrackpadThreeFingerMiddleClick`: 1 to enable three-finger middle-click
*   `$WidgetTrackpadInertialCursor`: 1 to enable inertial cursor
*   `$WidgetTrackpadBigCursor`: 1 to enable big cursor

#### Macro Pad (Experimental)[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#macro-pad-experimental "Direct link to Macro Pad (Experimental)")

A menu can drive a physical macro pad (e.g. Stream Deck hardware). The binding is independent of `$Availability` — any menu can be shown on screen normally AND drive a pad at the same time; set `$Availability` to 6 (macro pad only) to additionally hide it from normal on-screen display. Select the device via:

*   `$MacroPadSerial` (menu-level $Config): lowercase serial number of the macro pad this menu drives, or `model:<key>` to bind any connected device of that model (shareable in presets since it doesn't reference a specific unit; e.g. `model:elgato-stream-deck-plus`, Mirabox uses `model:mirabox-<vid>-<pid>` hex keys, Loupedeck uses names like `model:loupedeck-live` / `model:razer-stream-controller`; Stream Decks reached through BTT's Stream Deck plugin instead of direct HID get their own keys with a `-plugin-mode` suffix, e.g. `model:elgato-stream-deck-plus-plugin-mode`, because plugin mode cannot tell the 15-key hardware generations apart), or `family:<key>` to bind any connected device of a whole brand: `family:elgato` (every directly connected Stream Deck — e.g. one menu driving both a Stream Deck + and a Stream Deck Neo), `family:elgato-plugin-mode`, `family:mirabox` (Mirabox/AJAZZ Stream Dock), `family:loupedeck` (Loupedeck and the Razer Stream Controller rebadges). A family binding is what makes ONE menu definition usable across models with different surfaces: items the bound device cannot show are simply dropped (strip items on a pad without a touch strip, dial items on a pad without encoders, items beyond the key count flow onto further pages). More specific always wins for the same device: serial > `model:` > `family:`. Empty/omitted = not bound to a pad
*   `$MacroPadIsDefault` (menu-level $Config): 1 = this is the menu the pad shows at startup when several menus are bound to the same device (which is normal — that is how ©PredefinedActionType 618 switches between them). Without it the winner is whichever menu comes first in the list, so mark one when you have more than one. App-specific menus still take precedence over global ones regardless of this flag

Items of a macro-pad-bound menu support these additional properties:

*   `§HardwarePlacement`: hardware surface the item is placed on: 0=automatic (default: knob items → dials AND additionally mirrored onto the LCD strip so the dials stay self-documenting, everything else → LCD keys), 1=LCD keys, 2=dials/knobs only (opt out of the strip mirroring, leaving the strip entirely to explicitly placed items), 3=LCD strip, 4=plain buttons without a display (Loupedeck's round RGB buttons, the AKP03/M18 plain buttons; these cannot be reached by the ordinary key flow on devices that reserve them, and the item's colour is shown on the button's LED where the hardware has one). Ordering within a surface follows the normal item order. Explicitly placed strip items and mirrored knob items are not mutually exclusive — the strip shows all of them together, laid out left to right using each item's own size/margins (so e.g. four mirrored knob gauges plus a few extra strip items work)
*   `§MacroPadNavigation`: turns an ordinary item into a macro pad navigation control, so paging/back can be styled like any other item instead of using the generated chevrons: 0/omitted=normal item, 1=previous page, 2=next page, 3=back (leave submenu). Such an item is taken out of the normal key flow and occupies the reserved navigation slot, is shown only while that navigation is actually possible (no "previous" on the first page), and pressing it navigates instead of running its actions. If no item declares 3, a Back Button item (©TriggerType 777) in the menu is used as the back control automatically
*   Row Breaker items (`©TriggerType` 801) act as key-grid layout markers on a macro pad: the item after the breaker starts on the next row of the key grid, so items can be grouped without padding the gaps with dummy items. A breaker does nothing when it is leading, when the next free key already starts a row, when it directly follows another breaker, or when nothing follows it on the same page — so one used purely to separate sections in the on-screen menu (e.g. the keys from the knob items) has no effect on the device. Column Breakers are ignored, as is everything on a transport that does not report a grid width (Stream Deck plugin mode)
*   The repeat-while-held properties `§RepeatRate`/`§RepeatDelay` (see Interaction) work for macro pad keys too
*   LCD strip swipes are bindable on the CONTAINER, not per item (the strip is shared by everything on it): a menu (©TriggerType 767) or submenu (774) can hold actions in `©ActionCategorySwipeLeft` (51) / `©ActionCategorySwipeRight` (52) for a swipe on the touch strip of the pad it drives. A direction that has actions assigned no longer pages the pad's keys — the actions replace paging for that direction; directions without actions keep the default swipe-to-page. Paging always stays reachable via the generated chevrons, `§MacroPadNavigation` items and actions 621/622. While a submenu is open on the pad, that submenu's swipe actions apply. Swipe paging follows the on-screen controls: swipe RIGHT = next page, matching the direction the ">>" chevron and the next-page key point. `defaults write com.hegenberg.BetterTouchTool BTTMacroPadSwipeLeftIsNextPage -bool YES` switches to the content-follows-finger mapping instead (swipe left = next, like flicking a page away). Assigned swipe actions are unaffected and always follow the physical direction
*   Stream Decks driven through BTT's Stream Deck plugin (instead of direct HID) only expose the keys and dials on which the BetterTouchTool tile was placed in Elgato's software, so the pad's usable key count changes when the user switches Elgato profile or page. Dials and the touch strip (`§HardwarePlacement` 2 / 3) additionally require Stream Deck software 6.6 or later; there each dial owns an independent 200x100 touch strip segment, which BTT composes into (and slices back out of) one strip canvas

Pads driven by a floating menu can also be navigated programmatically from any trigger or item action (these replace the old Stream Deck group actions):

*   `©PredefinedActionType` 472 (Open Floating Submenu) and 445 (Close Floating Submenu) apply to macro pads as well as to on-screen menus. Their action config accepts `"BTTMenuActionMacroPadDevice"`: a macro pad serial number (or `model:<key>` / `family:<key>`) limiting the action to that pad; empty/omitted = every pad currently driven by a floating menu. 472 resolves its target anywhere in the menu tree, so a pad can jump straight into a nested submenu
*   `©PredefinedActionType` 618 (Macro Pad: Show Menu) retargets a pad at a different floating menu: `"BTTGenericActionConfig"` = name (`$ElementIdentifier`, `$Name` as fallback) or UUID of the menu to show, empty = return the pad to whatever `$MacroPadSerial` binds it to; `"BTTGenericActionConfig2"` = optional pad serial as above (this is how one trigger targets one specific pad while leaving other pads alone). An override set by name SURVIVES application switches and is re-resolved each time, so an app-specific menu with that same name automatically takes over while that app is in front and the override returns to the global menu afterwards; an override given as a UUID stays pinned to exactly that menu. The override is cleared by running 618 with an empty menu name, or dropped automatically if its target menu is deleted or renamed
*   `©PredefinedActionType` 621 / 622 (Macro Pad: Next Page / Previous Page) page the pad, clamped to the available pages. `"BTTGenericActionConfig2"` = optional pad serial as above

#### Knob Items (©TriggerType 860)[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#knob-items-triggertype-860 "Direct link to Knob Items (©TriggerType 860)")

Knob items rotate via scroll / click-drag on screen and map to physical encoders on a macro pad. Rotation & press actions use the crown/dial action categories (rotate left/right ratchet, rotate left/right smooth = "while pressed", press down/up, standard tap on click). On a macro pad encoder, turning while the knob is held fires the smooth categories instead of the ratchet ones and consumes the press (no tap action on release). Configuration:

*   `§KnobMode`: 0=endless rotation (default), 1=fixed range (value clamped between min and max)
*   `§KnobMinValue`/`§KnobMaxValue`: value range for fixed-range knobs (defaults 0 / 100)
*   `§KnobStepValue`: value change per detent (default 1)
*   `§KnobHideValue`: 1 to hide the numeric value shown at the center of fixed-range knobs (default = shown)

#### Miscellaneous[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#miscellaneous "Direct link to Miscellaneous")

*   `$UseStyleForSubmenu`: 1 to inherit parent style
*   `$OverrideGlobalMenuSetttings`: 1 to override globals
*   `$CreatedViaScript`: 1 if script-created
*   `$OnlyCopyOpenCategories`: 1 for categories
*   `§Extras`: Extra data (future use)
*   `©AnimateUUID`: Animation trigger UUID
*   `©LastChangeUUID`: Last change UUID

#### Value-Producing Items (Slider 775 / Knob 860)[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#value-producing-items-slider-775--knob-860 "Direct link to Value-Producing Items (Slider 775 / Knob 860)")

Sliders and knobs report their exact value to the actions they fire, so actions can bind numeric fields to it (`BTTActionValueBindings`, see the Actions documentation) without any scripting.

Slider range — defaults reproduce the fixed 0…1 range sliders had before it was configurable:

*   `§SliderMinValue`: minimum (default 0)
*   `§SliderMaxValue`: maximum (default 1)
*   `§SliderStepValue`: step, 0/omitted = continuous
*   `§SliderDefaultValue`: starting value (default = minimum)

Knob range (fixed-range mode only, `§KnobMode` = 1):

*   `§KnobMinValue` (default 0), `§KnobMaxValue` (default 100), `§KnobStepValue` (default 1)

Update rate, for both item types:

*   `§ValueUpdateMode`: 0/omitted = run Value Changed actions continuously while changing, 1 = only when the change ends, 2 = both
*   `§ValueUpdateThrottleHz`: cap for continuous updates (default 30)

The matching action categories are `©ActionCategoryValueChanged` and `©ActionCategoryValueChangeEnd`. Value Change Ended always fires when the interaction ends, independent of the update mode. Slider values are intentionally **not** persisted across restarts; knob values are.

Actions (`§Actions`)[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#actions-actions "Direct link to actions-actions")

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    {  "©TriggerType": 773,  "©TriggerClass": "©TriggerTypeFloatingMenu",  "$Name": "Mission Control",  "$Config": {},  "§Actions": [{  "©PredefinedActionType": 5,  "©PredefinedActionName": "Mission Control",  "©Enabled": 1,  "©Order": 0  }]}

Item Triggers (`§Triggers`)[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#item-triggers-triggers "Direct link to item-triggers-triggers")

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Standard items (773) and submenu items (774) can have triggers (keyboard shortcuts, key sequences, trackpad gestures, mouse buttons) attached that execute the item like a click - only while the owning menu is focused/hovered/visible. They live in the item's `§Triggers` array (sibling of `§Actions`). Each entry is a regular trigger definition marked with `©ActionCategory` 50, plus:

*   `©MenuTriggerScope`: when the trigger is active. 0 or omitted = while the menu is focused OR hovered (default), 1 = only while focused, 2 = only while hovered, 4 = always while the menu is visible (caution: shortcuts without modifier keys then block that key in all apps while the menu shows), 8 = always active even while the menu is hidden (used for menu-level show/hide shortcuts).
*   `©PredefinedActionType` 603 ("Trigger Specific Floating Menu Item"): with no further config the trigger executes its parent item's assigned actions. Any other action can be assigned instead.

    {  "©TriggerType": 773,  "©TriggerClass": "©TriggerTypeFloatingMenu",  "$Name": "Keyboard Item",  "$Config": {},  "§Triggers": [{  "©TriggerType": 0,  "©TriggerClass": "©TriggerTypeKeyboardShortcut",  "©ActionCategory": 50,  "©MenuTriggerScope": 0,  "©ShortcutKeyCode": 11,  "©ShortcutModifierKeys": 0,  "©PredefinedActionType": 603  }]}

Menus (767) can also carry such trigger children themselves (any supported trigger type): a trigger with `©ActionCategory` 50, `©MenuTriggerScope` 8 and `©PredefinedActionType` 388 (Toggle Floating Menu; 386 = Show, 387 = Hide) whose action config contains `{"BTTMenuActionMenuID": "<menu uuid>"}` acts as a global shortcut that shows/hides the menu. The Hide action (387) additionally accepts `"BTTMenuActionReleaseFromMemory": 1` in that config: the targeted menu is then closed and its content (including cached web views) released from memory instead of just hidden — same behavior as `$CloseButtonReleasesMemory`, and it likewise overrides `$KeepCached`.

Related display keys:

*   `§AssignedShortcutLabel` ($Config of the item): derived display string of the assigned keyboard shortcut (read-only, maintained by BTT's configuration UI)
*   `§ShowShortcutHint`: 1 = render the assigned shortcut as a small hint label at the item's trailing edge
*   `$ShowItemShortcutHints` (menu-level $Config): 1 = show hint labels for all items that have assigned shortcuts

Default Values[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#default-values "Direct link to Default Values")

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Properties listed below can be **omitted** from `$Config` when their value matches the default — the runtime will behave identically whether the key is present-with-default or absent. This keeps exported JSON minimal.

### Defaults = 0[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#defaults--0 "Direct link to Defaults = 0")

`§MarginLeft`, `§MarginRight`, `§MarginTop`, `§MarginBottom`, `§MinWidth`, `§MinHeight`, `§ShadowEnabled`, `§ShadowEnabledDark`, `§ShadowEnabledAlt`, `§BorderWidth`, `§BorderWidthDark`, `§BorderWidthAlt`, `§PositioningMode`, `§X`, `§Y`, `§OffsetX`, `§OffsetY`, `§ImageOffsetX`, `§ImageOffsetY`, `§ImageOffsetXDark`, `§ImageOffsetXAlt`, `§ImageOffsetYDark`, `§ImageOffsetYAlt`, `§ImagePadding`, `§ImagePaddingDark`, `§ImagePaddingAlt`, `$TextOffsetX`, `$TextOffsetY`, `§BlurredBackground`, `§GlassEffect`, `§GlassEffectDark`, `§DisplayOrder`, `§ScrollDelta`, `§InternalProperty2`, `$DisableDrag`, `$CloseAfterAction`, `$CloseOnMoveMouseAway`, `$CloseOnKeyboardInput`, `$OffsetX`, `$OffsetY`, `$ResizeOnHover`, `$HighlightPizzaSlice`, `$HoverOnWholePizzaSlice`, `$PlaceFirstItemAtCenter`, `$WindowResizable`, `$HorizontalAlignment`, `$VerticalAlignment`, `$ShowIfWindowLevelEqualsEnabled`, `$AnimateShow`, `$AnimateShowDuration`, `$FrameWidthHovered`, `$FrameHeightHovered`, `$ScriptAlwaysRunOnFirstLoad`, `$ScriptAlwaysRunOnAppear`, `$ModifierKeys`, `$WidgetNowPlayingHideCover`, `$WidgetNowPlayingHideWhenNoPlayer`, `$WidgetNowPlayingHideWhenPaused`, `$WidgetWeatherLayout`, `$WidgetWeatherUnit`, `$WidgetWeatherHideWhenNoData`, `§HardwarePlacement`, `§MacroPadNavigation`, `§KnobMode`, `§KnobHideValue`, `§RepeatRate`, `$CloseButtonReleasesMemory`, `$AutomaticallyOptimizeImages`

### Defaults = 1[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#defaults--1 "Direct link to Defaults = 1")

`$TextMinimumScaleFactor`, `$OpacityActive`, `$OpacityInactive`, `§VisibleWhileActive`, `§VisibleWhileInactive`, `§ShowHoverEffect`, `§ShowIcon`, `§CloseOnClick`, `$AllowScrolling`, `$CloseOnOutsideClick`, `$WidgetWeatherAutoLocation`, `§KnobStepValue`

### Defaults = 2[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#defaults--2 "Direct link to Defaults = 2")

`§ScrollDeltaNormalMouse`

### Defaults = 5[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#defaults--5 "Direct link to Defaults = 5")

Example: Complete Menu[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#example-complete-menu "Direct link to Example: Complete Menu")

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    [{  "©TriggerType": 767,  "©TriggerClass": "©TriggerTypeFloatingMenu",  "©UUID": "menu-uuid",  "©Enabled": 1,  "$Name": "Example Menu",  "$Config": {    "$PositioningType": 1,    "$PositionRelativeTo": 3,    "$AnchorMenu": 1,    "$AnchorRelation": 1,    "$FrameWidth": 220,    "$FrameHeight": 300,    "$OpacityActive": 1,    "$OpacityInactive": 0.8,    "$LayoutDirection": 0,    "$VerticalSpacing": 5,    "$HorizontalSpacing": 5,    "$WindowLevel": 3,    "$CloseAfterAction": 1  },  "§s": [{    "©TriggerType": 773,    "©TriggerClass": "©TriggerTypeFloatingMenu",    "©UUID": "item-uuid",    "©Enabled": 1,    "$Name": "Click Me",    "$Config": {      "§VisibleWhileActive": 1,      "§VisibleWhileInactive": 1,      "§MinWidth": 100,      "§MinHeight": 50,      "§BackgroundType": 4,      "§BackgroundColor": "90, 180, 240, 255",      "§BackgroundColorHover": "120, 200, 255, 255",      "§CornerRadius": 10,      "§BorderWidth": 2,      "§BorderColor": "255, 255, 255, 128",      "$AttributedText": "{\\rtf1 Click Me}",      "§IconType": 2,      "§SFSymbolName": "hand.tap",      "§IconColor1": "255, 255, 255, 255"    },    "§Actions": [{      "©PredefinedActionType": 5,      "©PredefinedActionName": "Mission Control"    }]  }]}]

Color Format[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#color-format "Direct link to Color Format")

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Colors use "R, G, B, A" format (0-255): "255, 0, 0, 255" = opaque red

Import Method[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/floating-menu#import-method "Direct link to Import Method")

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    await ai.validate_btt_trigger_json({ trigger_json: theJSONAsString });await ai.validate_floating_menu_json({ menu_json: theJSONAsString });

Inspect both reports, fix validation errors and review warnings. Then import in a separate tool call:

    await ai.create_new_btt_trigger_from_json({ trigger_json: theJSONAsString });

For native Swift widgets, use `retrieve_floating_menu_widget_plugin_reference` and `compile_swift_plugin` to prepare the plugin, then reference its installed identifier with `$WidgetCustomPluginID` on an item of type `835`. The trigger creation tool accepts trigger/action objects; it does not install plugin sources from a preset wrapper.

# BetterTouchTool Documentation

[Skip to main content](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/basic-setup#__docusaurus_skipToContent_fallback)

On this page

Basic Setup[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/basic-setup#basic-setup "Direct link to Basic Setup")

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Setting up a trigger to show / hide the floating webview[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/basic-setup#setting-up-a-trigger-to-show--hide-the-floating-webview "Direct link to Setting up a trigger to show / hide the floating webview")

The floating webview works just like any other predefined action in BTT. Basically you first select a trigger, which can be anything BTT has to offer (e.g. Keyboard Shortcut, Touch Bar Button, Trackpad Gesture...). After that you assign the predefined action **Show Floating WebView/HTML Menu** to the trigger.

In case you want to launch the same webview using multiple different triggers, instead of duplicating it multiple times you can just assign it to a [Reusable Named Trigger](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/other-triggers/named-triggers)
.

### Loading HTML from a URL[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/basic-setup#loading-html-from-a-url "Direct link to Loading HTML from a URL")

Loading a website from a URL just requires you to enter the URL: ![mcc](https://docs.folivora.ai/assets/images/webviewurl-2522eafeef18c297800ee2a1b2059816.png)

### Loading from an HTML file in your Preset's data folder (recommended)[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/basic-setup#loading-from-an-html-file-in-your-presets-data-folder-recommended "Direct link to Loading from an HTML file in your Preset's data folder (recommended)")

Every Preset in BTT has its own data folder. You can access it via the preset menu. If you place HTML files etc. in that folder you can reference them by using the **BTT\_PRESET\_PATH** placeholder. For example, if you have a file called index.html in your preset's data folder, you can access it via BTT\_PRESET\_PATH/index.html. This is pretty useful, because it allows you to export your preset including the associated files, so if you want to share your webview config you can easily do that. ![mcc](https://docs.folivora.ai/assets/images/webview_preset_folder-ddbf9832de7cfd2137168ce83c793c2e.png)

### Providing HTML directly:[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/basic-setup#providing-html-directly "Direct link to Providing HTML directly:")

Of course you can also enter HTML directly. This is not recommended for larger sites, but might be helpful for testing: ![mcc](https://docs.folivora.ai/assets/images/webviewdirecthtml-18b1dc720bbc321fd2303366e283e106.png)

### Accessing images and other files on your disk[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/basic-setup#accessing-images-and-other-files-on-your-disk "Direct link to Accessing images and other files on your disk")

The webview does NOT support accessing files using the file:// protocol. However, if you need to access a locally stored file from your hard drive, you can use localfile:// instead. For example `<img src="localfile:///Users/test/images.png"/>`

Usually you should store all files used by the webview in the Preset's data directory. You can reference these files from within the webview using the presetfile:// protocol. For example `<img src="presetfile://image.png"/>`

### Refreshing the Content[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/basic-setup#refreshing-the-content "Direct link to Refreshing the Content")

By default the content of the webview will stay loaded in background and it is assumed that it doesn't change. However during development you often want to see the latest changes immediately. To achieve this, open the advanced section and select "Do NOT keep content active in background". Afterwards the webview will reload every time you hide/unhide it.

*   [Basic Setup](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/basic-setup#basic-setup)
    *   [Setting up a trigger to show / hide the floating webview](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/basic-setup#setting-up-a-trigger-to-show--hide-the-floating-webview)
        
    *   [Loading HTML from a URL](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/basic-setup#loading-html-from-a-url)
        
    *   [Loading from an HTML file in your Preset's data folder (recommended)](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/basic-setup#loading-from-an-html-file-in-your-presets-data-folder-recommended)

# Long Press | BetterTouchTool Documentation

[Skip to main content](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/stream-deck/long-press#__docusaurus_skipToContent_fallback)

On this page

This documentation uses the following example preset to explain some of the features. [Example Preset Direct Link](https://folivora.ai/releases/ExampleStreamDeck.bttpreset)

Short & Long Press[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/stream-deck/long-press#short--long-press "Direct link to Short & Long Press")

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

You can execute different actions when doing a long press, but still keep your default short press actions. To do this follow these steps:

1.  **Trigger On Key Up**: To configure a long press action for a Stream Deck Button, you first need to set the trigger condition to "Trigger on Key Up" (instead of key down).
    
2.  **Configure Long Press Action**: Check the "Trigger named trigger on long press" checkbox, then select (or create) a [Named Trigger](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/other-triggers/named-triggers)
     that will be executed if the button is long-pressed.
    
3.  **Cancel default action**: You have now configured the button to trigger its default actions on key up and you assigned a long press action (which will be executed when holding the button down). This means if you try to perform a long press and hold down the button, it would execute your long press action, but would also trigger the default actions when you release the button.  
      
    To prevent this you can check the **"Cancel action if any other action is executed while key was down"** checkbox. In our case this means it would cancel the standard "Key Up" action as soon as the long press action is triggered.
    

![](https://docs.folivora.ai/media/streamdeck_long_press_btn.png)  

*   [Short & Long Press](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/stream-deck/long-press#short--long-press)

Function[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/stream-deck/standard-button#function "Direct link to Function")

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Stream Deck Buttons can be used to trigger any sort of action in BetterTouchTool. In their standard configuration a button press triggers the assigned action sequence as soon as you press the button down.

Appearance[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/stream-deck/standard-button#appearance "Direct link to Appearance")

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

There are many ways to customize the appearance of Stream Deck buttons in BetterTouchTool:

*   Changing the background color
*   Using rich text including any color and font combination
*   Using all sorts of icons including SF Symbol icons (see [https://developer.apple.com/sf-symbols/](https://developer.apple.com/sf-symbols/)
    )

BetterTouchTool integrates a very basic rich text editor that lets you adjust fonts, colors & spacing. For more control you can also use the Apple Text Edit app and then just copy the formatted text into the BTT editor.

### Example: Adjusting Space Between Lines[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/stream-deck/standard-button#example-adjusting-space-between-lines "Direct link to Example: Adjusting Space Between Lines")

To adjust the spacing between lines select the "Other..." option from the spacing dropdown:

![](https://docs.folivora.ai/media/streamdeck_spacing.png)  

In BTT the "Line height - at most" setting works best to make smaller spacing:

![](https://docs.folivora.ai/media/streamdeck_line_height.png)

# BetterTouchTool Documentation

[Skip to main content](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#__docusaurus_skipToContent_fallback)

On this page

For complex plugins with multiple source files, resources, or third-party dependencies, you can create a full Xcode project that builds a plugin bundle.

For simpler plugins, consider using [Swift Source Plugins](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/swift-source-plugins)
 instead - they require no Xcode project.

Bundle Extensions[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#bundle-extensions "Direct link to Bundle Extensions")

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Each plugin type uses a specific bundle extension:

| Plugin Type | Extension | Protocol |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Touch Bar | `.btttouchbarplugin` | `BTTPluginInterface` |
| Stream Deck | `.bttstreamdeckplugin` | `BTTStreamDeckPluginInterface` |
| Floating Menu Widget | `.bttwidget` | `BTTFloatingMenuWidgetInterface` |
| Action | `.bttactionplugin` | `BTTActionPluginInterface` |
| Trigger | `.btttriggerplugin` | `BTTTriggerPluginInterface` |
| Launcher | `.bttlauncherplugin` | `BTTLauncherPluginInterface` |

Project Setup[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#project-setup "Direct link to Project Setup")

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 1\. Clone the Template Project[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#1-clone-the-template-project "Direct link to 1. Clone the Template Project")

    git clone git@github.com:folivoraAI/BetterTouchToolPlugins.git

Open `xcode-bundle-examples/BetterTouchToolPluginDevelopment.xcodeproj` in Xcode. It contains sample plugins and the required `BTTPluginSupport.framework`.

### 2\. Create a New Target[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#2-create-a-new-target "Direct link to 2. Create a New Target")

Add a new macOS **Bundle** target to the project. Set the bundle extension to match your plugin type (e.g. `.bttwidget`).

### 3\. Link BTTPluginSupport.framework[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#3-link-bttpluginsupportframework "Direct link to 3. Link BTTPluginSupport.framework")

Add `BTTPluginSupport.framework` to your target's **Frameworks and Libraries**. This framework provides:

*   `BTTPluginFormItem` - configuration form item class
*   `BTTFormConstants` - form field type constants
*   All plugin protocol definitions from `BTTPluginInterface.h`

### 4\. Configure Info.plist[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#4-configure-infoplist "Direct link to 4. Configure Info.plist")

Every plugin bundle must include these `Info.plist` keys:

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTPluginName` | String | Display name shown in BTT |
| `BTTPluginIdentifier` | String | Unique reverse-domain identifier (e.g. `com.yourname.myplugin`) |
| `BTTPluginType` | String | One of: `TouchBar`, `StreamDeck`, `FloatingMenuWidget`, `Action`, `Trigger`, `Launcher` |
| `BTTPluginIcon` | String | SF Symbol name (optional) |
| `NSPrincipalClass` | String | Fully qualified class name |

For Swift classes, set `NSPrincipalClass` to `$(PRODUCT_MODULE_NAME).ClassName`:

    <key>NSPrincipalClass</key><string>$(PRODUCT_MODULE_NAME).CPUUsagePlugin</string>

### 5\. Implement the Protocol[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#5-implement-the-protocol "Direct link to 5. Implement the Protocol")

Create your plugin class conforming to the appropriate protocol. See the individual plugin type pages for protocol details:

*   [Touch Bar Plugins](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/touch-bar)
    
*   [Stream Deck Plugins](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/stream-deck)
    
*   [Floating Menu Widget Plugins](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/floating-menu-widget)
    
*   [Action Plugins](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/action)
    
*   [Trigger Plugins](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/trigger)
    
*   [Launcher Plugins](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/launcher)
    

### 6\. Build and Test[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#6-build-and-test "Direct link to 6. Build and Test")

Build the project in Xcode. Find the built bundle under the **Products** group (right-click > Show in Finder), then install it by double-clicking or dragging it onto the BTT preferences window.

Distribution[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#distribution "Direct link to Distribution")

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Plugins distributed to other users **must be notarized** by Apple. This requires an Apple Developer account.

### 1\. Build/Archive[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#1-buildarchive "Direct link to 1. Build/Archive")

    xcodebuild archive \  -scheme YourPluginScheme \  -configuration Release \  -archivePath ./build/yourplugin.xcarchivecd build/yourplugin.xcarchive/Products/Library/Bundles/

### 2\. Code Sign[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#2-code-sign "Direct link to 2. Code Sign")

    codesign --deep \  -s "Developer ID Application: Your Name (TEAMID)" \  -f YourPlugin.bttwidget

Replace the identity string with your own Developer ID certificate and the extension with your plugin's bundle extension.

### 3\. Zip for Notarization[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#3-zip-for-notarization "Direct link to 3. Zip for Notarization")

    ditto -c -k --keepParent --rsrc YourPlugin.bttwidget YourPlugin.notarize.zip

### 4\. Submit for Notarization[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#4-submit-for-notarization "Direct link to 4. Submit for Notarization")

    xcrun notarytool submit YourPlugin.notarize.zip \  --apple-id "your@email.com" \  --team-id TEAMID \  --password "@keychain:notarization" \  --wait

### 5\. Staple the Notarization Ticket[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#5-staple-the-notarization-ticket "Direct link to 5. Staple the Notarization Ticket")

    xcrun stapler staple YourPlugin.bttwidget

### 6\. Zip for Distribution[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#6-zip-for-distribution "Direct link to 6. Zip for Distribution")

    ditto -c -k --keepParent --rsrc YourPlugin.bttwidget YourPlugin.zip

Share the resulting `.zip` file. Users install the plugin by unzipping it and double-clicking the bundle, or dragging it onto the BTT preferences window.

tip

Swift source plugins (`.swift` files) do not require notarization and can be shared directly. Only compiled Xcode bundle plugins need to go through the notarization process.

Source Code & Examples[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#source-code--examples "Direct link to Source Code & Examples")

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The full plugin source code, Xcode project templates, and sample plugins are available on GitHub:

[https://github.com/folivoraAI/BetterTouchToolPlugins/tree/master/xcode-bundle-examples](https://github.com/folivoraAI/BetterTouchToolPlugins/tree/master/xcode-bundle-examples)

*   [Bundle Extensions](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#bundle-extensions)
    
*   [Project Setup](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#project-setup)
    *   [1\. Clone the Template Project](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#1-clone-the-template-project)
        
    *   [2\. Create a New Target](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#2-create-a-new-target)
        
    *   [3\. Link BTTPluginSupport.framework](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#3-link-bttpluginsupportframework)
        
    *   [4\. Configure Info.plist](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#4-configure-infoplist)
        
    *   [5\. Implement the Protocol](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#5-implement-the-protocol)
        
    *   [6\. Build and Test](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#6-build-and-test)
        
*   [Distribution](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#distribution)
    *   [1\. Build/Archive](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#1-buildarchive)
        
    *   [2\. Code Sign](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#2-code-sign)
        
    *   [3\. Zip for Notarization](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#3-zip-for-notarization)
        
    *   [4\. Submit for Notarization](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#4-submit-for-notarization)
        
    *   [5\. Staple the Notarization Ticket](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#5-staple-the-notarization-ticket)
        
    *   [6\. Zip for Distribution](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/xcode-bundle-distribution#6-zip-for-distribution)

# Configuration Forms Reference | BetterTouchTool Documentation

[Skip to main content](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/configuration-forms#__docusaurus_skipToContent_fallback)

On this page

All plugin types support custom configuration forms that appear in the BTT sidebar when the user selects the plugin. Forms let users customize plugin behavior without editing code.

Creating a Configuration Form[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/configuration-forms#creating-a-configuration-form "Direct link to Creating a Configuration Form")

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Implement the `configurationFormItems()` class method and return a form group containing your fields:

    static func configurationFormItems() -> BTTPluginFormItem? {    let group = BTTPluginFormItem()    group.formFieldType = BTTFormTypeFormGroup    let textField = BTTPluginFormItem()    textField.formFieldType = BTTFormTypeTextField    textField.formLabel1 = "Label Text"    textField.formFieldID = "labelText"    textField.defaultValue = "Hello!"    group.formOptions = [textField]    return group}

Receiving Configuration Values[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/configuration-forms#receiving-configuration-values "Direct link to Receiving Configuration Values")

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Use plain field IDs in Swift form definitions, for example `labelText`. BTT stores and delivers the value under `plugin_var_labelText`. Already-prefixed IDs are also supported. A two-field item needs distinct `formFieldID` and `formFieldID2` values; both receive the same prefix normalization.

The callback differs by plugin type. Floating-menu widgets, Launcher plugins and trigger plugins use `[AnyHashable: Any]?`; Stream Deck and Touch Bar use `[AnyHashable: Any]`. Action plugins receive `[AnyHashable: Any]?` in `executeAction(withConfiguration:completionBlock:)`. See [Callback Signatures](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/swift-source-plugins#callback-signatures)
 for the complete table.

This fragment belongs inside a floating-menu widget that retains an `NSTextField` named `label`:

    func didReceiveNewConfigurationValues(_ configurationValues: [AnyHashable: Any]?) {    label.stringValue = configurationValues?["plugin_var_labelText"] as? String ?? "Hello!"    let size = configurationValues?["plugin_var_fontSize"] as? Double ?? 24    label.font = .systemFont(ofSize: CGFloat(size))    delegate?.requestWidgetUpdate(self)}

Update your retained view or observable model when configuration changes. A widget update request does not promise that BTT will call `makeWidgetView()` again. Perform UI changes on the main thread. The [greeting widget example](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/floating-menu-widget#configuration-forms)
 shows the complete pattern.

Launcher plugin settings are scoped to a plugin and launcher ID. Its callback receives merged form defaults and saved values with both plain and `plugin_var_` keys. A saved Launcher item's `instance.configuration` is a separate, plugin-owned `[String: Any]` dictionary; it does not automatically gain form prefixes.

[JSON Action Plugins](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/json-action-plugins)
 use a smaller, flat form loader and `@@@fieldID@@@` action placeholders. The Swift constants and properties below are not an exhaustive list of supported JSON fields; use the JSON plugin page for that format.

Form Field Types[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/configuration-forms#form-field-types "Direct link to Form Field Types")

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

| Type Constant | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `BTTFormTypeTextField` | Single-line text input |
| `BTTFormTypeTwoTextFields` | Two text fields side by side (use `formFieldID` and `formFieldID2`) |
| `BTTFormTypeTextArea` | Multi-line text input |
| `BTTFormTypeCheckbox` | Boolean toggle |
| `BTTFormTypeSlider` | Numeric slider (set `minValue`, `maxValue`, `dataType` to `BTTFormDataNumber`) |
| `BTTFormTypePopupButton` | Dropdown selector (set `formOptions` to an array of option items; if no `defaultValue` is set, BTT uses the first option) |
| `BTTFormTypeColorPicker` | Color picker |
| `BTTFormTypeImagePicker` | Image picker (value arrives as Base64 string) |
| `BTTFormTypeSeparator` | Visual separator line (no value) |
| `BTTFormTypeDescription` | Static description text (use `formLabel1` for content) |
| `BTTFormTypeTitleField` | Bold title/header text |
| `BTTFormTypeDetailTitleField` | Detailed title field |
| `BTTFormTypeFormGroup` | Container for nested fields (use `formOptions` for child items) |
| `BTTFormTypeButton` | Action button |
| `BTTFormTypeAppleScript` | AppleScript editor |
| `BTTFormTypeShellScript` | Shell script editor |
| `BTTFormTypeTabs` | Tab container |
| `BTTFormTypeModifiers` | Keyboard modifier picker |
| `BTTFormTypeCustomTextInsertDropDown` | Custom text dropdown |
| `BTTFormTypeMouseClickRecognizer` | Mouse gesture recorder |
| `BTTFormTypeScalingBezierPath` | Path drawing |
| `BTTFormTypeSelectorPopover` | Complex selector popover |

BTTPluginFormItem Properties[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/configuration-forms#bttpluginformitem-properties "Direct link to BTTPluginFormItem Properties")

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `formFieldID` | `String` | Unique identifier for this field. Use the plain key; values are passed with a `plugin_var_` prefix. |
| `formFieldID2` | `String` | Secondary field identifier (used by `BTTFormTypeTwoTextFields`) |
| `formFieldType` | `String` | One of the form field type constants above |
| `formLabel1` | `String` | Primary label displayed next to the field |
| `formLabel2` | `String` | Secondary label |
| `formOption` | `Any` | Option value (used for popup button options) |
| `defaultValue` | `Any` | Initial editor value; do not assume it is a runtime fallback for every plugin type |
| `dataType` | `BTTFormData*` | Data type hint |
| `minValue` | `NSNumber` | Minimum value (for sliders) |
| `maxValue` | `NSNumber` | Maximum value (for sliders) |
| `formOptions` | `[BTTPluginFormItem]` | Array of child items (for groups, popup buttons, tabs) |
| `formData` | `Data` | Raw data value |
| `formIcon` | `NSImage` | Icon image |
| `doubleClickFocus` | `Bool` | Whether to focus on double-click |
| `doubleClickActivate` | `Bool` | Whether to activate on double-click |
| `floats` | `Bool` | Float behavior flag |
| `autoSave` | `Bool` | Auto-save behavior |
| `shouldTriggerReload` | `Bool` | Whether changes trigger a reload |
| `saveLastStateToUserDefaults` | `Bool` | Persist last state to user defaults |

Data Types[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/configuration-forms#data-types "Direct link to Data Types")

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

| Constant | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTFormDataString` | 1   | String data |
| `BTTFormDataNumber` | 2   | Numeric data |
| `BTTFormDataJSON` | 3   | JSON data |
| `BTTFormDataIcon` | 5   | Icon data |
| `BTTFormDataData` | 6   | Raw data |

Common Patterns[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/configuration-forms#common-patterns "Direct link to Common Patterns")

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Text Field[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/configuration-forms#text-field "Direct link to Text Field")

    let field = BTTPluginFormItem()field.formFieldType = BTTFormTypeTextFieldfield.formLabel1 = "Title"field.formFieldID = "title"field.defaultValue = "Default Text"

### Slider[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/configuration-forms#slider "Direct link to Slider")

    let slider = BTTPluginFormItem()slider.formFieldType = BTTFormTypeSliderslider.formLabel1 = "Font Size"slider.formFieldID = "fontSize"slider.minValue = NSNumber(value: 10)slider.maxValue = NSNumber(value: 72)slider.defaultValue = NSNumber(value: 24)slider.dataType = BTTFormDataNumber

### Checkbox[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/configuration-forms#checkbox "Direct link to Checkbox")

    let checkbox = BTTPluginFormItem()checkbox.formFieldType = BTTFormTypeCheckboxcheckbox.formLabel1 = "Enable Feature"checkbox.formFieldID = "enabled"checkbox.defaultValue = NSNumber(value: true)

### Color Picker[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/configuration-forms#color-picker "Direct link to Color Picker")

    let colorPicker = BTTPluginFormItem()colorPicker.formFieldType = BTTFormTypeColorPickercolorPicker.formLabel1 = "Background Color"colorPicker.formFieldID = "bgColor"

### Dropdown / Popup Button[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/configuration-forms#dropdown--popup-button "Direct link to Dropdown / Popup Button")

    let popup = BTTPluginFormItem()popup.formFieldType = BTTFormTypePopupButtonpopup.formLabel1 = "Style"popup.formFieldID = "style"let opt1 = BTTPluginFormItem()opt1.formLabel1 = "Compact"opt1.formOption = "compact"let opt2 = BTTPluginFormItem()opt2.formLabel1 = "Detailed"opt2.formOption = "detailed"popup.formOptions = [opt1, opt2]popup.defaultValue = "compact" // optional; BTT uses the first option if omitted

### Image Picker[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/configuration-forms#image-picker "Direct link to Image Picker")

    let imagePicker = BTTPluginFormItem()imagePicker.formFieldType = BTTFormTypeImagePickerimagePicker.formLabel1 = "Icon"imagePicker.formFieldID = "icon"// Value arrives as a Base64-encoded string

### Description / Static Text[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/configuration-forms#description--static-text "Direct link to Description / Static Text")

    let desc = BTTPluginFormItem()desc.formFieldType = BTTFormTypeDescriptiondesc.formLabel1 = "This widget shows the current time and fires actions on minute/hour changes."

### Title / Section Header[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/configuration-forms#title--section-header "Direct link to Title / Section Header")

    let title = BTTPluginFormItem()title.formFieldType = BTTFormTypeTitleFieldtitle.formLabel1 = "Appearance Settings"

### Separator[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/configuration-forms#separator "Direct link to Separator")

    let separator = BTTPluginFormItem()separator.formFieldType = BTTFormTypeSeparator

### Grouping Fields[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/configuration-forms#grouping-fields "Direct link to Grouping Fields")

Wrap related fields in a form group:

    let group = BTTPluginFormItem()group.formFieldType = BTTFormTypeFormGrouplet title = BTTPluginFormItem()title.formFieldType = BTTFormTypeTitleFieldtitle.formLabel1 = "Display Settings"let fontSize = BTTPluginFormItem()fontSize.formFieldType = BTTFormTypeSliderfontSize.formLabel1 = "Font Size"fontSize.formFieldID = "fontSize"fontSize.minValue = NSNumber(value: 8)fontSize.maxValue = NSNumber(value: 48)fontSize.defaultValue = NSNumber(value: 16)fontSize.dataType = BTTFormDataNumbergroup.formOptions = [title, fontSize]
