# BetterTouchTool Documentation

[Skip to main content](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#__docusaurus_skipToContent_fallback)

On this page

Triggering Scripting Functions from any BetterTouchTool Web View[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#triggering-scripting-functions-from-any-bettertouchtool-web-view "Direct link to Triggering Scripting Functions from any BetterTouchTool Web View")

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Floating Web View allows you to trigger various scripting functions via JavaScript.

**Important Note**: When loaded the webview takes a few milliseconds to initialize BTT's scripting infrastructure. This is why you should only call the scripting functions after the BTTInitialized function has been called (or you can use some fixed delay). For more information see [webview lifecycle](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/lifecycle)

**The available scripting functions are:**

*   resize\_webview
*   trigger\_named
*   update\_touch\_bar\_widget
*   update\_stream\_deck\_widget
*   trigger\_action
*   execute\_assigned\_actions\_for\_trigger
*   refresh\_widget
*   get\_trigger
*   get\_triggers
*   update\_trigger (to create or if exists update a trigger)
*   add\_new\_trigger
*   delete\_trigger
*   delete\_triggers
*   trigger\_named
*   trigger\_named\_async\_without\_response
*   cancel\_delayed\_named\_trigger\_execution
*   get\_dock\_badge\_for
*   get\_active\_touch\_bar\_group
*   is\_true\_tone\_enabled
*   get\_location
*   set\_persistent\_string\_variable
*   set\_string\_variable
*   set\_persistent\_number\_variable
*   set\_number\_variable
*   get\_number\_variable
*   get\_string\_variable
*   export\_preset
*   display\_notification
*   paste\_text
*   set\_clipboard\_content
*   get-selected-text

Floating Menus:

*   update\_menu\_item
*   get\_menu\_item\_value
*   set\_menu\_item\_value
*   webview\_menu\_item\_load\_html\_url\_js

**Note: There are some built-in variables, which can also be quite helpful**:

[Built-In Scripting Variables](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/scripting/variables)

* * *

There are two ways to trigger these scripting functions, both are equally powerful:

### **1.) Using the bttweb:// links**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#1-using-the-bttweb-links "Direct link to 1-using-the-bttweb-links")

bttweb:// is a custom URL scheme which allows you to trigger scripting functions and retrieve their results, just like any other http call. You can use them in normal `a` elements `<a href="bttweb://trigger_named/?trigger_name=test"></a>` or use XMLHTTPRequest or fetch for this.

The general format for bttweb:// links is always `bttweb://**scripting_function_name**/?arg1=xxx&arg2=yyy&arg....`

**Loading bttweb links using fetch with async/await:** // a little helper function

    async function bttwebRequest(requestPath) {    const response = await fetch(requestPath);    const responseText = await response.text();    return responseText;}let result = await bttwebRequest('bttweb://trigger_named/?trigger_name=test');

* * *

### **2.) Using The Scripting Interface via JavaScript.**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#2-using-the-scripting-interface-via-javascript "Direct link to 2-using-the-scripting-interface-via-javascript")

BetterTouchTool automatically injects JavaScript functions into any HTML loaded into the floating HTML View. Using these you can trigger the scripting interfaces mentioned above.

* * *

### Closing the webview[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#closing-the-webview "Direct link to Closing the webview")

You can close the floating webview by passing the closeFloatingWebView set to 1. E.g. `trigger_named({trigger_name: 'test', closeFloatingWebView:1})`;

* * *

### Example script function calls:[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#example-script-function-calls "Direct link to Example script function calls:")

### **resize\_webview**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#resize_webview "Direct link to resize_webview")

This method will resize the floating webview to the specified width and height.

#### Example[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#example "Direct link to Example")

    await resize_webview({"width" :100, "height": 250});

* * *

### **trigger\_named**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#trigger_named "Direct link to trigger_named")

This method will trigger the specified named trigger (which can be configured in the "Other" tab in BetterTouchTool.)

#### Example[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#example-1 "Direct link to Example")

    let result = await trigger_named({trigger_name: 'Action5'});// Currently only the AppleScript and Shell Script actions return results.

or

    <a href="bttweb://trigger_named/trigger_name=Action5">

* * *

### **trigger\_named\_async\_without\_response**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#trigger_named_async_without_response "Direct link to trigger_named_async_without_response")

This method will trigger the specified named trigger (which can be configured in the "Other" tab in BetterTouchTool.). It won't wait for a response.

#### Example[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#example-2 "Direct link to Example")

    trigger_named_async_without_response({trigger_name: 'Action5'});// Currently only the AppleScript and Shell Script actions return results.

or

    <a href="bttweb://trigger_named_async_without_response/trigger_name=Action5">

* * *

### **update\_touch\_bar\_widget**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#update_touch_bar_widget "Direct link to update_touch_bar_widget")

This method will update the contents of a Touch Bar Script Widget (identified by its uuid). You can provide a new text to show, a new icon and a new background color.

For the icon you can either provide it directly using the icon\_data parameter (must be base64 encoded) or you can provide a file path (via the icon\_path parameter) that points to the new icon.

You can get the uuid by right-clicking any script widget in BTT.

#### Example:[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#example-3 "Direct link to Example:")

    let widgetConfig = {	text: "hi there!",	icon_path: "/Users/andi/Desktop/test.png",	background_color: "200,100,100,255"	};update_touch_bar_widget({uuid: '9990CE09-9820-4D67-9C52-8BABAB263056', json: widgetConfig});

* * *

### **trigger\_action**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#trigger_action "Direct link to trigger_action")

This method will trigger any of BetterTouchTool's predefined actions (or any combination of them).

You need to provide a JSON description of the action you want to trigger as a string. The easiest way to get such a JSON description is to right-click the trigger you have configured in BetterTouchTool and choose "Copy JSON". This will copy the complete JSON (including the configuration for the trigger itself), but this action will ignore anything that's not needed. (or you can delete the not needed parts)

#### Example:[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#example-4 "Direct link to Example:")

    let actionDefinition = {  "BTTPredefinedActionType" : 153,   "BTTPredefinedActionName" : "Move Mouse To Position",   "BTTMoveMouseToPosition" : "{100, 100}",   "BTTMoveMouseRelative" : "6"};let result = await trigger_action({json: JSON.stringify(actionDefinition)});

* * *

### **execute\_assigned\_actions\_for\_trigger**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#execute_assigned_actions_for_trigger "Direct link to execute_assigned_actions_for_trigger")

This method executes all the assigned actions for a given trigger (i.e. gesture, shortcut, drawing etc.) identified by its uuid.

You can get the uuid by right-clicking any configured trigger in BetterTouchTool.

#### Example[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#example-5 "Direct link to Example")

    let result = await execute_assigned_actions_for_trigger({uuid: '2F34005D-4537-464D-94E9-A7F42DA39DF1'});// Currently only the AppleScript and Shell Script actions return results.

Or

    <a href="bttweb://execute_assigned_actions_for_trigger/?uuid=2F34005D-4537-464D-94E9-A7F42DA39DF1">Trigger</a>

* * *

### **refresh\_widget**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#refresh_widget "Direct link to refresh_widget")

This method will execute all scripts assigned to a script widget and update its contents accordingly.

The widget is identified by its uuid, which you can get by right-clicking the widget in BetterTouchTool.

#### Example[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#example-6 "Direct link to Example")

    refresh_widget({uuid: '2F34005D-4537-464D-94E9-A7F42DA39DF1'});

Or

    <a href="bttweb://refresh_widget/?uuid=2F34005D-4537-464D-94E9-A7F42DA39DF1">Refresh Widget</a>

* * *

### **update\_trigger**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#update_trigger "Direct link to update_trigger")

This method will create or update the configuration of any specified trigger (i.e. gestures, shortcuts, touchbar items etc.).

You need to provide the uuid of the trigger you want to update (get by right-clicking it in BTT) and a JSON object defining the updates. To know how the JSON object should look like, right-click the trigger in BTT and choose "Copy JSON".

#### Example:[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#example-7 "Direct link to Example:")

Hint: don't forget to use JSON.stringify() before passing the updateDefinition object.

    var updateDefinition = {	"BTTTouchBarButtonName" : "New Name",	"BTTTouchBarItemIconHeight" : 25}update_trigger({uuid: '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000', json: JSON.stringify(updateDefinition)});

* * *

### **get\_trigger**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#get_trigger "Direct link to get_trigger")

This allows you to retrieve the JSON configuration of a trigger identified by its UUID.

    let triggerJSONString = await get_trigger({uuid:'123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000'})let parsedJSON = JSON.parse(triggerJSONString);console.log('parsed json:', parsedJSON);

* * *

### **add\_new\_trigger**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#add_new_trigger "Direct link to add_new_trigger")

This method will add a new trigger to BTT (i.e. gestures, shortcuts, touchbar items etc.).

You need to provide a JSON object defining the new trigger. To know how the JSON object should look like, right-click any existing trigger in BTT and choose "Copy JSON".

#### Example[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#example-8 "Direct link to Example")

    var newTriggerDefinition = {  "BTTTriggerClass" : "BTTTriggerTypeKeyboardShortcut",  "BTTPredefinedActionType" : 5,  "BTTPredefinedActionName" : "Mission Control",  "BTTAdditionalConfiguration" : "1179648",  "BTTTriggerOnDown" : 1,  "BTTEnabled" : 1,  "BTTShortcutKeyCode" : 2,  "BTTShortcutModifierKeys" : 1179648,  "BTTOrder" : 3}add_new_trigger({json: JSON.stringify(newTriggerDefinition)});

### **delete\_trigger**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#delete_trigger "Direct link to delete_trigger")

This method will delete a trigger from BetterTouchTool. You need to provide the uuid of the trigger you want to delete (get by right-clicking it in BTT).

#### Example[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#example-9 "Direct link to Example")

    delete_trigger({uuid: '2F34005D-4537-464D-94E9-A7F42DA39DF1'});

Or

    <a href="bttweb://delete_trigger/?uuid=2F34005D-4537-464D-94E9-A7F42DA39DF1">Delete Trigger</a>

* * *

### **get\_clipboard\_content**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#get_clipboard_content "Direct link to get_clipboard_content")

Gives you the current text content of the clipboard.

#### Example[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#example-10 "Direct link to Example")

    (async ()=> {let result = await get_clipboard_content({format: "public.html" /*optional*/, asBase64: false, excludeConcealed: false});returnToBTT(result);})();

For the format parameter you can use any possible UTI or one of these strings:

Default formats are (more are possible):

*   all - returns all currently stored formats as a JSON string
*   NSPasteboardTypeString
*   NSPasteboardTypeTIFF
*   NSPasteboardTypePNG
*   NSPasteboardTypeRTF
*   NSPasteboardTypeRTFD
*   NSPasteboardTypeHTML
*   NSPasteboardTypeTabularText
*   NSPasteboardTypeFont
*   NSPasteboardTypeRuler
*   NSPasteboardTypeColor
*   NSPasteboardTypeSound
*   NSPasteboardTypeMultipleTextSelection
*   NSPasteboardTypeTextFinderOptions
*   NSPasteboardTypeURL
*   NSPasteboardTypeFileURL

* * *

### **get\_selection**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#get_selection "Direct link to get_selection")

Gives you the currently selected text/item

#### Example[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#example-11 "Direct link to Example")

    (async ()=> {let result = await get_selection({format: "public.html" /*optional*/, asBase64: false});returnToBTT(result);})();

For the format parameter you can use any possible UTI or one of these strings:

Default formats are (more are possible):

*   NSPasteboardTypeString
*   NSPasteboardTypeTIFF
*   NSPasteboardTypePNG
*   NSPasteboardTypeRTF
*   NSPasteboardTypeRTFD
*   NSPasteboardTypeHTML
*   NSPasteboardTypeTabularText
*   NSPasteboardTypeFont
*   NSPasteboardTypeRuler
*   NSPasteboardTypeColor
*   NSPasteboardTypeSound
*   NSPasteboardTypeMultipleTextSelection
*   NSPasteboardTypeTextFinderOptions
*   NSPasteboardTypeURL
*   NSPasteboardTypeFileURL

* * *

### **set\_persistent\_string\_variable**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#set_persistent_string_variable "Direct link to set_persistent_string_variable")

This allows you to set a variable to a given string that persists over BTT relaunches.

#### JavaScript for Automation Example:[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#javascript-for-automation-example "Direct link to JavaScript for Automation Example:")

    set_persistent_string_variable({variable_name: 'test', to: "this is a test value"});

* * *

### **set\_string\_variable**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#set_string_variable "Direct link to set_string_variable")

This allows you to set a variable to a given string. This variable will NOT persist over BTT relaunches.

    set_string_variable({variable_name: 'test', to: "this is a test value"});

* * *

### **set\_persistent\_number\_variable**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#set_persistent_number_variable "Direct link to set_persistent_number_variable")

This allows you to set a variable to a given number that persists over BTT relaunches.

    set_persistent_number_variable({variable_name: 'test', to: 12345});

* * *

### **set\_number\_variable**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#set_number_variable "Direct link to set_number_variable")

This allows you to set a variable to a given number. This variable will NOT persist over BTT relaunches.

    set_number_variable({variable_name:'OutputVolume', to: 0.5});

* * *

### **get\_number\_variable**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#get_number_variable "Direct link to get_number_variable")

This allows you to retrieve the contents of a number variable with the given name

    let result = await get_number_variable({variable_name:'OutputVolume'})

* * *

### **get\_string\_variable**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#get_string_variable "Direct link to get_string_variable")

This allows you to retrieve the contents of a string variable with the given name

    let result = await get_string_variable({variable_name:'BTTActiveAppBundleIdentifier'})

* * *

* * *

### **display\_notification**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#display_notification "Direct link to display_notification")

This shows a notification

    let result = await display_notification({title:'notification title', subTitle: 'some subtitle', soundName: 'frog', imagePath: '~/Downloads/image.png'})

* * *

### **paste\_text**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#paste_text "Direct link to paste_text")

This pastes some text

Parameters:

**text**: The text to paste.

**insert\_by\_pasting**: If set to true BTT will use cmd+v to paste the text. Otherwise it will actually try to type it (only possible for standard formats)

**move\_cursor\_left\_by\_x\_after\_pasting**: If specified BTT will move the cursor by the given amount to the left.

**format**: Optional. The format the text will be interpreted as when pasting (e.g. if you want to paste a table, you can set the string to `<table>...</table>` and specify the format NSPasteboardTypeHTML) Note, this only works if insert\_by\_pasting is set to true.

Default formats are (more are possible):

*   NSPasteboardTypeString
*   NSPasteboardTypeTIFF
*   NSPasteboardTypePNG
*   NSPasteboardTypeRTF
*   NSPasteboardTypeRTFD
*   NSPasteboardTypeHTML
*   NSPasteboardTypeTabularText
*   NSPasteboardTypeFont
*   NSPasteboardTypeRuler
*   NSPasteboardTypeColor
*   NSPasteboardTypeSound
*   NSPasteboardTypeMultipleTextSelection
*   NSPasteboardTypeTextFinderOptions
*   NSPasteboardTypeURL
*   NSPasteboardTypeFileURL

    let result = await paste_text({text:'<strong>Hello world</strong>', format: 'NSPasteboardTypeHTML', insert_by_pasting: true})

* * *

### **set\_clipboard\_content**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#set_clipboard_content "Direct link to set_clipboard_content")

Changes the content of the clipboard

Parameters:

**content**: The content to put in your clipboard. **format**: Optional. The format the content will be interpreted as when pasting (e.g. if you want to paste a table, you can use set the string to

...

and specify the format NSPasteboardTypeHTML)

Default formats are (more are possible):

*   NSPasteboardTypeString
*   NSPasteboardTypeTIFF
*   NSPasteboardTypePNG
*   NSPasteboardTypeRTF
*   NSPasteboardTypeRTFD
*   NSPasteboardTypeHTML
*   NSPasteboardTypeTabularText
*   NSPasteboardTypeFont
*   NSPasteboardTypeRuler
*   NSPasteboardTypeColor
*   NSPasteboardTypeSound
*   NSPasteboardTypeMultipleTextSelection
*   NSPasteboardTypeTextFinderOptions
*   NSPasteboardTypeURL
*   NSPasteboardTypeFileURL

    let result = await set_clipboard_content({content:'<strong>Hello world</strong>', format: 'NSPasteboardTypeHTML'})

* * *

### **get\_items\_from\_clipboard\_manager**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#get_items_from_clipboard_manager "Direct link to get_items_from_clipboard_manager")

This function allows you to retrieve arbitrary items from the BTT clipboard manager (if the clipboard manager is active)

Parameters:

*   **start**: The offset from which to start retrieving items.
*   **numberOfItems**: The number of items to retrieve starting from **start**
*   **format**: Optional: the format you want to retrieve. This defaults to NSPasteboardTypeString (standard string). If you set it to **all** it will retrieve all stored formats for every item. For other supported formats scroll up to the previous _set\_clipboard\_content_ function.
*   **snippetGroup**: Optional: the name of the snippet group you want to retrieve from
*   **asBase64**: Return the content as base64 encoded string
*   **selected**: Optional: if set to true, this will return the currently selected items from the open clipboard manager window, in the order they were selected. When using this parameter, **start**, **numberOfItems** and **snippetGroup** are ignored. Returns an empty items array if no clipboard manager window is open or no items are selected.

    async function retrieveItems() {    //additional supported parameters: format, snippetGroup, asBase64 and selected    // if format is set to "all", it will return all stored information about the requested items, apart from "all" it supports any pasteboard UTI	return get_items_from_clipboard_manager({start: 0, numberOfItems: 5});}async function retrieveSelectedItems() {    // retrieve the currently selected items from the open clipboard manager, in selection order    return get_items_from_clipboard_manager({selected: true});}

The output of this will be a JSON string, you need to use JSON.parse(result) to convert it to a JavaScript object:

    {  "items" : [       {      "meta" : {        "copiedFrom" : "com.sublimetext.4",        "uuid" : "1B1F7F7D-EF28-4B45-9AF1-248768BFCB8C",        "previewText" : "Test5",        "date" : "2025-10-01T13:25:09Z"      },      "content" : "Test5"    },    {      "meta" : {        "copiedFrom" : "com.sublimetext.4",        "uuid" : "10C6C74F-8373-4810-909E-544318EC4ED7",        "previewText" : "Test4",        "date" : "2025-10-01T13:25:08Z"      },      "content" : "Test4"    },    {      "meta" : {        "copiedFrom" : "com.sublimetext.4",        "uuid" : "D8956BBC-7699-43D7-BF22-3E648B05D631",        "previewText" : "Test3",        "date" : "2025-10-01T13:25:08Z"      },      "content" : "Test3"    },    {      "meta" : {        "copiedFrom" : "com.sublimetext.4",        "uuid" : "A9880066-4438-4CD2-A103-FB7E3CAD47FC",        "previewText" : "Test2",        "date" : "2025-10-01T13:25:07Z"      },      "content" : "Test2"    },    {      "meta" : {        "copiedFrom" : "com.sublimetext.4",        "uuid" : "0BD5D9D6-B76D-4E91-99E9-5B59F9067C44",        "previewText" : "Test1",        "date" : "2025-10-01T13:25:07Z"      },      "content" : "Test1"    }  ],  "latest" : "2025-10-01T13:25:14Z"}

* * *

### **paste\_clipboard\_manager\_items\_with\_uuids**[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/webview/javascript#paste_clipboard_manager_items_with_uuids "Direct link to paste_clipboard_manager_items_with_uuids")

This function will paste one or more specific items from the BTT clipboard manager (if the clipboard manager is active)

Parameters:

*   **uuids**: A comma separated string with the UUIDs of the clipboard manager items you want to paste. To retrieve these UUIDs use the _get\_items\_from\_clipboard\_manager_ function
*   **deleteAfterPaste**: if true, the pasted items will be removed from the clipboard manager

    async function pasteSomeItems() {    //additional supported parameters: deleteAfterPaste	return paste_clipboard_manager_items_with_uuids({uuids: "0BD5D9D6-B76D-4E91-99E9-5B59F9067C44,A9880066-4438-4CD2-A103-FB7E3CAD47FC"});}

* * *

To access the currently selected text, make use of the selected\_text variable like this:

    let selectedText = await get_string_variable({variable_name:'selected_text'})

# BetterTouchTool Documentation

[Skip to main content](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/stream-deck/swift-plugins#__docusaurus_skipToContent_fallback)

On this page

Moved to Plugins Section

The full plugin documentation has been consolidated into a dedicated **Plugins** section. Please see:

*   **[Stream Deck Plugins](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/stream-deck)
    ** - full protocol reference, all 4 rendering options, button handling, delegate methods
*   **[Swift Source Plugins](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/swift-source-plugins)
    ** - how to create simple `.swift` file plugins (no Xcode required)
*   **[Plugin Overview](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/overview)
    ** - overview of all plugin types and development approaches

BetterTouchTool allows you to add your own custom Swift or Objective-C plugins for the Stream Deck.

For a quick start, create a `.swift` file and drop it onto the BTT preferences window:

    // BTT-Plugin-Name: Counter// BTT-Plugin-Type: StreamDeck// BTT-Plugin-Icon: number.circle.fillimport Cocoaclass Counter: NSObject, BTTStreamDeckPluginInterface {    weak var delegate: (any BTTStreamDeckPluginDelegate)?    private var count = 0    static func configurationFormItems() -> BTTPluginFormItem? { nil }    func widgetTitleStrings() -> [String]? {        return ["\(count)"]    }    func buttonDown(_ identifier: String) -> Bool {        count += 1        delegate?.requestUpdate(self)        return false    }    func buttonUp(_ identifier: String) -> Bool {        return false    }}

See the [Stream Deck Plugins](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/plugins/stream-deck)
 page for the complete documentation including all rendering options, appearance configuration, and delegate methods.

Example: CPU Usage Plugin[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/stream-deck/swift-plugins#example-cpu-usage-plugin "Direct link to Example: CPU Usage Plugin")

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A ready-to-use CPU usage plugin is available for download: [http://folivora.ai/releases/BTTStreamDeckPluginCPUUsage.zip](http://folivora.ai/releases/BTTStreamDeckPluginCPUUsage.zip)

The source code is available on GitHub: [https://github.com/folivoraAI/BetterTouchToolPlugins/tree/master/xcode-bundle-examples/BTTStreamDeckPluginCPUUsage](https://github.com/folivoraAI/BetterTouchToolPlugins/tree/master/xcode-bundle-examples/BTTStreamDeckPluginCPUUsage)

Plugins can be installed in either `~/Library/Application Support/BetterTouchTool/Plugins/` or `/Library/Application Support/BetterTouchTool/Plugins/`

*   [Example: CPU Usage Plugin](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/stream-deck/swift-plugins#example-cpu-usage-plugin)

# Notch Bar Setup | BetterTouchTool Documentation

[Skip to main content](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/notch-bar/setup#__docusaurus_skipToContent_fallback)

The Notch Bar setup allows you to hide or show specific containers on the Notch Bar.

One important setting is the "Show original status icons" option. This allows you to either show the real macOS status items or hide them to make space for other things. If you decide to hide the original status icons for some mode, you can still use the "Status Items Widget" to get access to a subset of your items.

By default the original status icons are shown while in Menubar Mode but are hidden in Widget Mode.

![notchbar-setup](https://docs.folivora.ai/assets/images/notchbar_settings-be7eb09861e00f65c9522daf8cfda7c5.jpg)

# BetterTouchTool Documentation

[Skip to main content](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#__docusaurus_skipToContent_fallback)

On this page

This document provides a reference for creating trigger configurations in BetterTouchTool using JSON.

Basic Trigger Structure[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#basic-trigger-structure "Direct link to Basic Trigger Structure")

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This complete example binds Command-Space to the action shown below. Trigger identity and required configuration depend on the trigger class; read that class's section before choosing key codes or properties.

    {  "BTTTriggerType": 0,  "BTTTriggerClass": "BTTTriggerTypeKeyboardShortcut",  "BTTShortcutKeyCode": 49,  "BTTShortcutModifierKeys": 1048576,  "BTTTriggerOnDown": 1,  "BTTActionsToExecute": [    {      "BTTPredefinedActionType": 45    }  ]}

Required Fields[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#required-fields "Direct link to Required Fields")

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTTriggerType` | Number | The specific trigger ID (see trigger types below) |
| `BTTTriggerClass` | String | The trigger category (must match the trigger type) |

Common Optional Fields[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#common-optional-fields "Direct link to Common Optional Fields")

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

| Field | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTUUID` | String | Unique identifier | Auto-generated |
| `BTTTriggerTypeDescription` | String | User-visible name/description. A custom label only; it never selects or changes the gesture | Auto-generated |
| `BTTTriggerTypeDescriptionReadOnly` | String | The gesture's native name in exported JSON. The AI creation tool also uses it to check the intended name for top-level trackpad/Magic Mouse gestures (see below) | Native name |
| `BTTEnabled` | Number | Enable/disable trigger (0 or 1) | 1   |
| `BTTEnabled2` | Number | Secondary enabled state | 1   |
| `BTTOrder` | Number | Sort order in list | Auto |
| `BTTActionsToExecute` | Array | Actions to perform | \[\] |
| `BTTRequiredModifierKeys` | Number | Modifier keys that must be held (see Modifier Keys section) | None |

Trigger Categories[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#trigger-categories "Direct link to Trigger Categories")

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 1\. Trackpad Gestures[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#1-trackpad-gestures "Direct link to 1. Trackpad Gestures")

**BTTTriggerClass Options**:

*   `"BTTTriggerTypeTouchpadAll"` - All trackpads
*   `"BTTTriggerTypeTouchpadBuiltIn"` - Built-in only
*   `"BTTTriggerTypeTouchpadMagicTrackpad"` - Magic Trackpad 1
*   `"BTTTriggerTypeTouchpadMagicTrackpad2"` - Magic Trackpad 2
*   `"BTTTriggerTypeTouchBarTrackpad"` - Touch Bar surface

The following names and IDs are generated from BTT’s native catalog. A custom `BTTTriggerTypeDescription` only changes the label; use `BTTTriggerTypeDescriptionReadOnly` in readback to verify the gesture.

**AI creation guard:** `create_new_btt_trigger_from_json` requires the requested gesture's native name when creating a top-level trackpad gesture. Supply `BTTTriggerTypeDescriptionReadOnly` in the JSON or `expected_trigger_name` as a separate tool argument for a single trigger. For a batch, include the JSON field in each top-level trackpad/Magic Mouse object instead of passing the single-trigger argument. The tool compares the name with the native name of `BTTTriggerType`, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace. A missing required name or mismatch stops the call before import begins. Ordinary JSON/preset imports treat the read-only field as display metadata; the mandatory name check belongs to this AI tool and does not apply to children created under a parent. Preserve the intended name and look up the correct ID after a mismatch.

#### Long Touch & Circle Gesture Configuration[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#long-touch--circle-gesture-configuration "Direct link to Long Touch & Circle Gesture Configuration")

**Long Touch gestures** trigger after fingers have been held stationary for a configurable duration.

*   `BTTAdditionalConfiguration` (String): Duration in seconds before the gesture triggers. Range: 0.1–5.0, default: 0.5. Example: `"BTTAdditionalConfiguration": "0.8"`.

**Circle gestures** trigger when one finger draws a circular motion on the trackpad or Magic Mouse surface.

*   `BTTAdditionalConfiguration` (String): Number of circles required before the gesture triggers. Fractional values are supported (e.g. 0.9 = 90% of a circle). Range: 0.5–20, default: 0.9. Example: `"BTTAdditionalConfiguration": "0.9"`.
*   The gesture re-triggers on every additional full circle after the initial trigger.
*   When the value is 1.0 or less, the circle must be completed within 2.5 seconds of initial touch to avoid false triggers. This time limit does not apply for higher values.

### 3\. Other Triggers / Automations[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#3-other-triggers--automations "Direct link to 3. Other Triggers / Automations")

**BTTTriggerClass**: `"BTTTriggerTypeOtherTriggers"`

#### Named Trigger / Reusable Trigger Reference[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#named-trigger--reusable-trigger-reference "Direct link to Named Trigger / Reusable Trigger Reference")

*   `643` - Reusable Named Trigger

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTTriggerName` | String | The unique name for this trigger (used to call it from other triggers/scripts) |
| `BTTNamedTriggerAIDescription` | String | Description for AI/h@llo.ai (what this trigger does) |
| `BTTNamedTriggerAIAllow` | Number | Allow [h@llo.ai](mailto:h@llo.ai)<br> to use this trigger (0/1) |
| `BTTCustomContextMenuItemConfig` | Object | Variable declarations (see below) |

A named trigger can declare up to two variables, independently of `BTTNamedTriggerAIAllow`. They are declared in the `BTTCustomContextMenuItemConfig` object and work like function parameters: they are only set when a caller (the "Trigger Named Trigger" action, `trigger_named` via AppleScript / web server, App Intents, AI) provides a value, and they are always temporary (never persisted).

| `BTTCustomContextMenuItemConfig` key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTNamedTriggerAIRequiresVariables` | Bool | Whether this named trigger uses variables. If absent, variables count as declared whenever a variable name is set |
| `BTTNamedTriggerAIVar1Name` | String | Name of the first variable |
| `BTTNamedTriggerAIVar1Type` | Number | 0 (default) = set as a text variable, 1 = set as a number variable (string values passed via `trigger_named` are converted to numbers) |
| `BTTNamedTriggerAIVar1Options` | String | Newline separated list of suggested values for the first variable (shown as autocomplete when calling this trigger) |
| `BTTNamedTriggerAIVar1Description` | String | What the first variable is for |
| `BTTNamedTriggerAIVar2Name` | String | Name of the second variable |
| `BTTNamedTriggerAIVar2Type` | Number | 0 (default) = set as a text variable, 1 = set as a number variable (string values passed via `trigger_named` are converted to numbers) |
| `BTTNamedTriggerAIVar2Options` | String | Newline separated list of suggested values for the second variable (shown as autocomplete when calling this trigger) |
| `BTTNamedTriggerAIVar2Description` | String | What the second variable is for |

    {  "BTTTriggerType": 643,  "BTTTriggerClass": "BTTTriggerTypeOtherTriggers",  "BTTTriggerName": "my_custom_trigger",  "BTTNamedTriggerAIDescription": "Trigger for opening Safari",  "BTTNamedTriggerAIAllow": 1,  "BTTCustomContextMenuItemConfig": {    "BTTNamedTriggerAIRequiresVariables": true,    "BTTNamedTriggerAIVar1Name": "mode",    "BTTNamedTriggerAIVar1Options": "dark\nlight",    "BTTNamedTriggerAIVar1Description": "Which appearance to switch to"  },  "BTTActionsToExecute": [{    "BTTPredefinedActionType": 49  }]}

#### Launcher Simple JSON Item[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#launcher-simple-json-item "Direct link to Launcher Simple JSON Item")

*   `849` - Launcher Simple JSON Item

A trigger that provides dynamic items for the BetterTouchTool Launcher. The trigger runs a JavaScript function (default `retrieveJSON`) that must return items in the [Simple JSON Format](http://docs.folivora.ai/docs/1108_simple_format.html)
. The trigger itself appears as a top-level launcher item, and activating it runs the script and shows the returned items as launcher children.

The script is stored as a JSON object in the trigger's secondary action data. The script must be configured using the BetterTouchTool UI script editor.

The trigger's display name comes from `BTTLauncherTitle` in its `BTTTriggerLauncherConfig`. The launcher config should have `BTTLauncherShowInLauncher` set to `1` (or `3` for always visible) so the item appears in the launcher.

    {  "BTTTriggerType": 849,  "BTTTriggerClass": "BTTTriggerTypeOtherTriggers",  "BTTTriggerLauncherConfig": {    "BTTLauncherShowInLauncher": 1,    "BTTLauncherTitle": "My Custom Items"  },  "BTTActionsToExecute": []}

#### Application Lifecycle[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#application-lifecycle "Direct link to Application Lifecycle")

*   `670` - App Did Launch
*   `671` - App Did Activate
*   `672` - App Did Deactivate
*   `673` - App Did Terminate
*   `779` - App Did Change (Focus Changed to Different App)
*   `604` - Switch to Application (triggers when switching to the app this trigger is assigned to)

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTAdditionalConfiguration` | String | App path/URL to watch (e.g. `"file:///Applications/Safari.app/"`). Omit to trigger for any app. |

    {  "BTTTriggerType": 670,  "BTTTriggerClass": "BTTTriggerTypeOtherTriggers",  "BTTAdditionalConfiguration": "file:///Applications/Safari.app/",  "BTTActionsToExecute": [{    "BTTPredefinedActionType": 371,    "BTTAdditionalActionData": { "BTTActionSendNotificationMessage": "Safari launched!" }  }]}

Note: `604` (Switch to Application) and `779` (App Did Change) do not use `BTTAdditionalConfiguration` — they trigger based on the app assignment scope (which app group the trigger is in).

#### OSC Message Received[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#osc-message-received "Direct link to OSC Message Received")

*   `850` - OSC Message Received

Fires when an Open Sound Control (OSC) message is received by BetterTouchTool's built-in OSC receiver. The receiver must be enabled in BetterTouchTool's settings (Variables & Scripting > OSC), where the listen address (default `127.0.0.1`) and port (default `8000`) are configured.

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTAdditionalConfiguration` | String | OSC address filter (e.g. `/btt/fader1`). Also accepts a regular expression that must match the whole incoming address (e.g. `/btt/fader.*`). Leave empty to trigger for any incoming OSC address. |

**Variables available when triggered:** `BTTOSCAddress`, `BTTOSCArgsJSON`, `BTTOSCArg0`, `BTTOSCArg0Type`, `BTTOSCPath0`, `BTTOSCSourceHost`, `BTTOSCReceiveCounter` (and related indexed `BTTOSCArgN` / `BTTOSCArgNType` / `BTTOSCPathN` variables).

    {  "BTTTriggerType": 850,  "BTTTriggerClass": "BTTTriggerTypeOtherTriggers",  "BTTAdditionalConfiguration": "/btt/fader1",  "BTTActionsToExecute": [{    "BTTPredefinedActionType": 371,    "BTTAdditionalActionData": { "BTTActionSendNotificationMessage": "Received OSC message!" }  }]}

#### Left-Click Dock App Icon[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#left-click-dock-app-icon "Direct link to Left-Click Dock App Icon")

*   `851` - Left-Click Dock App Icon

Fires when an application icon in the macOS Dock is left-clicked. By default the original Dock click is consumed, so the configured actions fully replace the normal Dock behavior. Only application icons are matched — folders, minimized windows and the Trash are ignored.

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTAdditionalConfiguration` | String | File URL of a specific app to match (e.g. `file:///Applications/Safari.app/`). If omitted, the trigger uses the app from the section it is assigned to, or matches every application icon in the Dock when assigned to "All Apps". |

The "also pass the original click through to the Dock" option can currently only be configured via the BetterTouchTool UI, not via JSON.

**Variables available when triggered:** `hovered_dock_app_name`, `hovered_dock_app_path`, `hovered_dock_app_bundleidentifier`

For activate/restore/minimize behavior, combine this trigger with the predefined action "Dock App Click: Activate / Restore / Minimize".

    {  "BTTTriggerType": 851,  "BTTTriggerClass": "BTTTriggerTypeOtherTriggers",  "BTTAdditionalConfiguration": "file:///Applications/Safari.app/",  "BTTActionsToExecute": [{    "BTTPredefinedActionType": 371,    "BTTAdditionalActionData": { "BTTActionSendNotificationMessage": "Safari Dock icon clicked!" }  }]}

#### Mouse Hovers Dock App Icon[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#mouse-hovers-dock-app-icon "Direct link to Mouse Hovers Dock App Icon")

*   `861` - Mouse Hovers Dock App Icon (macOS 13+)

Runs assigned actions once after the pointer dwells on a native Dock application icon. Shares app targeting with Left-Click Dock App Icon; folders, minimized windows and Trash are ignored. No global Settings switch is needed: enabled triggers install the event monitor.

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTAdditionalConfiguration` | String | Optional app file URL. Without one, uses the app section, or all Dock app icons in the All Apps section. |
| `BTTDelayBeforeTriggering` | Number | Hover delay in seconds, 0.15–3; omitted/zero defaults to 0.45. |

**Saved variables:** `hovered_dock_app_name`, `hovered_dock_app_bundleidentifier`, and `hovered_dock_app_path` contain the app name, bundle identifier, and filesystem path captured after the hover delay, before dispatching the assigned actions. They are available to actions, scripts, and conditions; supported text fields can use placeholders such as `{hovered_dock_app_name}`. Values remain available after the pointer leaves the Dock until the next matching Dock hover/click or BetterTouchTool quits. Non-running apps supply these variables too; a missing bundle identifier is saved as an empty string. These are the same variable names used by Left-Click Dock App Icon. Before any Dock trigger saves them, they are resolved from the current pointer position.

Assign **Show Window Switcher for Active App** to show the hovered app's windows beside its icon, using that action's full layout, thumbnail, filter and interaction configuration. The target is captured per invocation and retained across action-chain delays; presentation is canceled if the pointer leaves the hover session. Non-running apps can trigger other actions, but have no windows to show. **Show Window switcher for All Open Apps** retains its normal scope and positioning.

Moving into the Dock switcher keeps it open; moving away dismisses it unless the action's keep-open option is enabled. Screen Recording must already be allowed for automatic switcher presentation. Matching Dock hover triggers take precedence over Focus Follows Mouse's Dock app activation.

#### Razer Mouse DPI Stage Changed[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#razer-mouse-dpi-stage-changed "Direct link to Razer Mouse DPI Stage Changed")

*   `859` - Razer Mouse DPI Stage Changed

Fires when a supported Razer mouse (Basilisk V3 family) announces a DPI change via its passive input-report channel — typically because the hardware DPI button was pressed or the on-device stage was cycled. The DPI button itself is handled entirely by the mouse's firmware and emits no normal HID event, so this trigger is the only way to react to it. No configuration properties.

**Variables available when triggered:** `razer_dpi` (new horizontal DPI), `razer_dpi_stage` (1-based stage index, 0 if the value doesn't match a known stage), `razer_device` (display name of the mouse).

    {  "BTTTriggerType": 859,  "BTTTriggerClass": "BTTTriggerTypeOtherTriggers",  "BTTActionsToExecute": [{    "BTTPredefinedActionType": 371,    "BTTAdditionalActionData": { "BTTActionSendNotificationMessage": "DPI is now {razer_dpi}" }  }]}

#### File Did Change[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#file-did-change "Direct link to File Did Change")

*   `807` - File Did Change

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTGenericActionConfig` | String | File/folder paths to watch (separate multiple paths with `;;`). `~` is expanded. |
| `BTTFileChangeType` | Number | What type of change to watch for (see values below) |

**BTTFileChangeType values:**

*   `0` - All changes (default)
*   `1` - Directory Created
*   `2` - Directory Removed
*   `3` - Directory Renamed
*   `4` - Directory Modified
*   `5` - File Created
*   `6` - File Removed
*   `7` - File Renamed / Moved Into Folder
*   `8` - File Modified
*   `9` - File Moved Out Of Folder

Watching a directory also reports changes in its subdirectories. `.DS_Store` and editor scratch files (vim swap files, `*~` backups, emacs lock/autosave files) are ignored so that a single save does not produce several triggers.

**Variables available when triggered:** `BTTLastChangedFileOrFolder`, `BTTLastChangedFileOrFolderChangedType`

warning

`BTTLastChangedFileOrFolderChangedType` is **0-based** and is therefore always **one lower** than the `BTTFileChangeType` value used to configure the trigger. It reports `-1` if the change type could not be determined.

| Variable value | Meaning | Matching `BTTFileChangeType` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0` | Directory Created | `1` |
| `1` | Directory Removed | `2` |
| `2` | Directory Renamed | `3` |
| `3` | Directory Modified | `4` |
| `4` | File Created | `5` |
| `5` | File Removed | `6` |
| `6` | File Renamed / Moved Into Folder | `7` |
| `7` | File Modified | `8` |
| `8` | File Moved Out Of Folder | `9` |

This off-by-one is kept for backwards compatibility with existing scripts and conditions.

    {  "BTTTriggerType": 807,  "BTTTriggerClass": "BTTTriggerTypeOtherTriggers",  "BTTGenericActionConfig": "/Users/me/Documents;;/Users/me/Desktop",  "BTTFileChangeType": 8,  "BTTActionsToExecute": [{    "BTTPredefinedActionType": 371,    "BTTAdditionalActionData": { "BTTActionSendNotificationMessage": "File modified!" }  }]}

#### Accelerometer (Apple Silicon)[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#accelerometer-apple-silicon "Direct link to Accelerometer (Apple Silicon)")

Accelerometer triggers use the built-in Bosch BMI286 IMU on Apple Silicon MacBooks.

##### Axis Threshold Triggers[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#axis-threshold-triggers "Direct link to Axis Threshold Triggers")

*   `838` - Accelerometer X-Axis Goes Above
*   `839` - Accelerometer X-Axis Goes Below
*   `840` - Accelerometer Y-Axis Goes Above
*   `841` - Accelerometer Y-Axis Goes Below
*   `842` - Accelerometer Z-Axis Goes Above
*   `843` - Accelerometer Z-Axis Goes Below

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTRepeatDelay` | Number | Threshold value in g (e.g. 0.5 means 0.5g) |
| `BTTTriggerOnDown` | Number | If 1, trigger fires on the very first accelerometer reading if threshold is already crossed |

The re-trigger prevention delta (how much the value must change before the trigger can fire again) can currently only be configured via the BetterTouchTool UI, not via JSON.

    {  "BTTTriggerType": 842,  "BTTTriggerClass": "BTTTriggerTypeOtherTriggers",  "BTTRepeatDelay": -0.9,  "BTTTriggerOnDown": 0,  "BTTActionsToExecute": [{    "BTTPredefinedActionType": 371,    "BTTAdditionalActionData": { "BTTActionSendNotificationMessage": "Z-axis crossed -0.9g (laptop tilted!)" }  }]}

##### Shake / Abrupt Movement[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#shake--abrupt-movement "Direct link to Shake / Abrupt Movement")

*   `844` - Accelerometer Detects Shake / Abrupt Movement

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTRepeatDelay` | Number | Magnitude threshold in g — fires when combined per-sample delta across all axes exceeds this value |

    {  "BTTTriggerType": 844,  "BTTTriggerClass": "BTTTriggerTypeOtherTriggers",  "BTTRepeatDelay": 0.3,  "BTTActionsToExecute": [{    "BTTPredefinedActionType": 371,    "BTTAdditionalActionData": { "BTTActionSendNotificationMessage": "Shake detected!" }  }]}

##### Impact / Tap Detection (STA/LTA)[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#impact--tap-detection-stalta "Direct link to Impact / Tap Detection (STA/LTA)")

*   `845` - Accelerometer Detects Light Tap on Chassis
*   `846` - Accelerometer Detects Knock on Chassis
*   `847` - Accelerometer Detects Hard Hit / Slap on Chassis

These use a Short-Term Average / Long-Term Average (STA/LTA) algorithm with a high-pass filter to detect impulsive events independent of device orientation.

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTRepeatDelay` | Number | Sensitivity (1–10, default 5). Lower = more sensitive, higher = stronger impact required |

The required number of taps/knocks (e.g. 3 for triple-knock) can currently only be configured via the BetterTouchTool UI, not via JSON.

    {  "BTTTriggerType": 846,  "BTTTriggerClass": "BTTTriggerTypeOtherTriggers",  "BTTRepeatDelay": 5,  "BTTActionsToExecute": [{    "BTTPredefinedActionType": 371,    "BTTAdditionalActionData": { "BTTActionSendNotificationMessage": "Double knock detected!" }  }]}

*   `834` - Audio Input Changed

#### Power Mode Changed[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#power-mode-changed "Direct link to Power Mode Changed")

*   `848` - Power Mode Did Change

Fires when the macOS energy mode changes (e.g. switching between Automatic, Low Power, High Power in System Settings > Battery). Sets the BTT variable `power_mode` to the current mode.

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTAdditionalConfiguration` | String | Which power mode to trigger on: `all`, `automatic`, `low-power`, or `high-power` |

When `BTTAdditionalConfiguration` is set to a specific mode (e.g. `low-power`), the trigger only fires when switching to that mode. Use `all` to fire on every power mode change.

    {  "BTTTriggerType": 848,  "BTTTriggerClass": "BTTTriggerTypeOtherTriggers",  "BTTAdditionalConfiguration": "low-power",  "BTTActionsToExecute": [{    "BTTPredefinedActionType": 371,    "BTTAdditionalActionData": { "BTTActionSendNotificationMessage": "Switched to Low Power mode" }  }]}

#### Trigger Plugin[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#trigger-plugin "Direct link to Trigger Plugin")

*   `837` - Trigger Plugin

Trigger plugins are custom Swift plugins that observe arbitrary system events and fire BTT triggers when conditions are met. They appear under Other Triggers > Trigger Plugins in the trigger selector.

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTAdditionalConfiguration` | String | Plugin bundle identifier (selects which trigger plugin to use) |
| `BTTAdditionalData` | JSON object | Optional per-trigger plugin configuration values, keyed as `plugin_var_<fieldID>` |

The plugin identifier is stored in `BTTAdditionalConfiguration` (internally `gestureConfig`). When a trigger plugin fires, any context values it provides are stored as BTT variables with the `TriggerPlugin_` prefix (e.g. context key `clipboardContent` becomes variable `TriggerPlugin_clipboardContent`).

Plugin-specific configuration values (defined by the plugin's `configurationFormItems`) are stored alongside the trigger in `BTTAdditionalData` / `icondata3` with keys prefixed by `plugin_var_`. Plugin authors can use plain `formFieldID` values such as `watchPath`; BTT adds the `plugin_var_` prefix when saving and when passing values to `didReceiveNewConfigurationValues(_:)`.

    {  "BTTTriggerType": 837,  "BTTTriggerClass": "BTTTriggerTypeOtherTriggers",  "BTTAdditionalConfiguration": "com.example.myTriggerPlugin",  "BTTAdditionalData": {    "plugin_var_watchPath": "~/Desktop"  },  "BTTActionsToExecute": [{    "BTTPredefinedActionType": 371,    "BTTAdditionalActionData": { "BTTActionSendNotificationMessage": "Plugin triggered!" }  }]}

### 4\. Keyboard Shortcuts[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#4-keyboard-shortcuts "Direct link to 4. Keyboard Shortcuts")

**BTTTriggerClass**: `"BTTTriggerTypeKeyboardShortcut"`

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTShortcutKeyCode` | Number | macOS virtual key code |
| `BTTShortcutModifierKeys` | Number | Modifier key flags (see Modifier Keys section) |
| `BTTTriggerOnDown` | Number | Trigger on key down (1) or key up (0). **Default: 1** — always set to 1 unless key-up triggering is explicitly needed |
| `BTTLayoutIndependentChar` | String | Layout-independent character (the character the key produces, e.g. `"a"`, `"s"`) |
| `BTTAutoAdaptToKeyboardLayout` | Number | Auto-adapt to keyboard layout (0/1) |
| `BTTShortcutAdvancedModifierKeys` | String | Advanced modifier key combination as string (same value as `BTTShortcutModifierKeys` but as string, e.g. `"1179658"`) |
| `BTTAdditionalConfiguration` | String | Additional modifier configuration as string (typically same value as `BTTShortcutAdvancedModifierKeys`) |
| `BTTShortcutKeyboardType` | Number | Keyboard type identifier (internal keyboard ID, e.g. `-2052004921`). Optional — omit to match any keyboard |
| `BTTShortcutScope` | Number | Where shortcut is active |
| `BTTKeyboardShortcutMinTime` | Number | Minimum hold time in seconds |
| `BTTKeyboardShortcutMaxTime` | Number | Maximum hold time in seconds |
| `BTTKeyboardShortcutPerformDefaultOnAdvancedConditionMismatch` | Boolean | If true and this trigger has advanced conditions that evaluate to false, BetterTouchTool will pass the original keyboard event through so the frontmost app can handle it normally. Only applies to the standard action category — triggers with key long-press, release, or other keyboard action categories will still be swallowed. Default: false |

    {  "BTTTriggerType": 0,  "BTTTriggerClass": "BTTTriggerTypeKeyboardShortcut",  "BTTTriggerOnDown": 1,  "BTTShortcutKeyCode": 49,  "BTTShortcutModifierKeys": 1048576,  "BTTLayoutIndependentChar": "space",  "BTTActionsToExecute": [{    "BTTPredefinedActionType": 45  }]}

#### Keyboard Device Configuration Triggers[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#keyboard-device-configuration-triggers "Direct link to Keyboard Device Configuration Triggers")

These special keyboard-class triggers configure a whole external keyboard instead of reacting to a single shortcut:

*   `1340` - Logitech Keyboard Configuration (configured via BTT UI)
*   `1346` - Work Louder Keyboard Configuration

The Work Louder configuration makes the keys of a Work Louder keyboard / macro pad (Codex Micro, XYZ, Creator Micro V2, Nomad E, Knob, ...) report to BTT. On QMK based models BTT rewrites the keyboard's on-device layout (other device settings are preserved, the original layout is backed up on the device); on the Codex Micro the OpenAI firmware already reports every key press, so BTT listens passively and never modifies the layout. Once applied, press a key on the Work Louder keyboard while recording a normal Keyboard Shortcut trigger to assign actions to it (keys are recorded as "Work Louder N"; Codex Micro: agent keys 0-5, action keys 6-12, encoder left/right/click 13/14/15). Works without the Work Louder app running — BTT re-applies the configuration automatically whenever the device connects (USB or Bluetooth). Note: the Codex Micro can NOT be used while the ChatGPT / Codex desktop app has it open (that app claims the device exclusively). Supports one optional action category: "Action Executed After Keyboard Initialization" (executed after each successful apply, e.g. to set LED colors via predefined action 626).

The Work Louder configuration is stored as a JSON object in `BTTAdditionalDataJSON`:

| Property (inside BTTAdditionalDataJSON) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTWorkLouderDeviceName` | String | Display name of the keyboard to configure. Empty/omitted = any connected Work Louder keyboard |
| `BTTWorkLouderDivertAllKeys` | Boolean | Send all keys to BTT (recommended for macro pads). Default: true |
| `BTTWorkLouderRecordedKeys` | Array of Number | Key indices to divert when `BTTWorkLouderDivertAllKeys` is false (recorded via the BTT UI) |
| `BTTWorkLouderKeyColor` | String | Optional LED color for diverted keys as hex string, e.g. `"#FF3300"` |
| `BTTWorkLouderExcludedApps` | Array | Apps where the keyboard keeps its default behavior. Each entry: `{"bundleId": "...", "name": "...", "process": "...", "path": "..."}` |

    {  "BTTTriggerType": 1346,  "BTTTriggerClass": "BTTTriggerTypeKeyboardShortcut",  "BTTAdditionalDataJSON": {    "BTTWorkLouderDeviceName": "",    "BTTWorkLouderDivertAllKeys": true,    "BTTWorkLouderKeyColor": "#FF3300"  }}

### 7\. Normal Mouse[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#7-normal-mouse "Direct link to 7. Normal Mouse")

**BTTTriggerClass**: `"BTTTriggerTypeNormalMouse"`

Normal mouse triggers use button numbers for trigger type IDs. The formula is:

*   Single click: `1000 + buttonNumber` (button 0=left, 1=right, 2=middle, 3-99=extra buttons)
*   Double click: `1100 + buttonNumber`
*   Triple click: `1200 + buttonNumber`
*   Quadruple click: `1300 + buttonNumber` (buttons 0-23 and 48-99 only — `1324`\-`1347` are used by unrelated trigger types)
*   Scroll: `996`\=scroll down, `997`\=scroll up, `998`\=scroll left, `999`\=scroll right

#### Mouse Device Configuration Triggers[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#mouse-device-configuration-triggers "Direct link to Mouse Device Configuration Triggers")

These special normal-mouse-class triggers configure a whole external mouse instead of reacting to a single button:

*   `1324` - Logitech Mouse Configuration (configured via BTT UI)
*   `1347` - Razer Mouse Configuration

The Razer configuration row stores persistent settings for a Razer mouse (DPI stages, polling rate, wireless idle timeout, low battery threshold, lighting) and re-applies them automatically when the mouse connects or the Mac wakes. Works over USB cable, HyperSpeed dongle and direct Bluetooth (over Bluetooth, polling rate and low battery threshold are skipped - the mouse protocol does not expose them there). Settings are written to the mouse's onboard memory where supported, so they also persist without BTT. Supports one optional action category: "Action Executed After Mouse Initialization". Configured via the BTT UI; the settings are stored as a JSON object in `BTTAdditionalDataJSON` with these properties: `BTTRazerMouseName` (string, empty = all Razer mice), `BTTRazerCfgDPIStages` (string, comma separated DPI values e.g. `"400, 800, 1600"`), `BTTRazerCfgActiveStage` (number, 1-based), `BTTRazerCfgPollingRate` (number, 0 = don't manage / 125 / 500 / 1000), `BTTRazerCfgIdleTimeout` (number, seconds 60-900, 0 = don't manage), `BTTRazerCfgLowBatteryThreshold` (number, percent 5-25, 0 = don't manage), `BTTRazerCfgLightingMode` (number, -1 = don't manage, 0 = off, 1 = static, 2 = spectrum, 3 = breathing, 4 = wave), `BTTRazerCfgLightingColor` (string `"r,g,b,a"`), `BTTRazerCfgApplyBrightness` (boolean), `BTTRazerCfgLightingBrightness` (number 0-100), `BTTRazerCfgRemapSlot<N>` (string, on-device button remap for slot N; targets: `default`, `disable`, `left_click`/`right_click`/`middle_click`/`back`/`forward`, `scroll_up`/`scroll_down`, `dpi_cycle`, `f13`…`f24` to make the button send an F-key that can be recorded as a normal BTT Keyboard Shortcut, or `key:MM:KK` raw hex modifier+HID key; slots: 3 middle, 4 back, 5 forward, 9/10 scroll, 15 clutch, 52/53 wheel tilt, 96 DPI button).

#### Logitech Thumb Wheel Touch (Button 50)[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#logitech-thumb-wheel-touch-button-50 "Direct link to Logitech Thumb Wheel Touch (Button 50)")

Button number `50` is reserved for the capacitive thumb wheel touch sensor of supported Logitech mice (the MX Master line - MX Master 3, 3S and 4 report the required touch capability). These triggers only fire while "Allow Thumb Wheel Touch As A Button" is enabled in that mouse's Logitech configuration. Resting a finger on the wheel then acts like holding a mouse button (so long press and drag gestures work), a quick touch is a tap:

*   `1050` - Thumb Wheel Touch
*   `1150` - Thumb Wheel Double Tap
*   `1250` - Thumb Wheel Triple Tap
*   `1350` - Thumb Wheel Quadruple Tap

While this is enabled BTT takes over the thumb wheel, so its horizontal scrolling is synthesized by BTT instead of by the mouse itself.

    {  "BTTTriggerType": 1004,  "BTTTriggerClass": "BTTTriggerTypeNormalMouse",  "BTTActionsToExecute": [{    "BTTPredefinedActionType": 45  }]}

Floating menus use `BTTMenuConfig` for detailed layout and style properties. See the Floating Menu reference tool for full documentation.

#### Knob Item (860)[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#knob-item-860 "Direct link to Knob Item (860)")

A rotary knob item. On screen it rotates via scrolling or click-dragging; on a macro pad it maps to a physical dial/encoder (experimental — the menu is bound to a pad via `BTTMenuMacroPadSerial` in its `BTTMenuConfig`, independent of `BTTMenuAvailability`; availability 6 = "Macro Pad Only" additionally hides the menu from normal on-screen display). Rotation and press events reuse the crown/dial action category keys:

| JSON Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `BTTActionsToExecute` | Knob tap / click |
| `BTTActionCategoryCrownRotateLeftRatchet` | Rotate left (one detent) |
| `BTTActionCategoryCrownRotateRightRatchet` | Rotate right (one detent) |
| `BTTActionCategoryCrownRotateLeftSmooth` | Rotate left while the knob is held down (shown as "Actions Executed On Rotate Left (While Pressed)") |
| `BTTActionCategoryCrownRotateRightSmooth` | Rotate right while the knob is held down (shown as "Actions Executed On Rotate Right (While Pressed)") |
| `BTTActionCategoryCrownPressDown` | Knob press down |
| `BTTActionCategoryCrownPressUp` | Knob press up |

Knob behavior is configured via `BTTMenuConfig`: `BTTMenuItemKnobMode` (0/omitted = endless rotation, 1 = fixed range), `BTTMenuItemKnobMinValue` / `BTTMenuItemKnobMaxValue` / `BTTMenuItemKnobStepValue` (fixed-range value settings, step defaults to 1) and `BTTMenuItemKnobHideValue` (1 = hide the numeric value display in the knob center). On a macro pad encoder the "Smooth" categories are the press-and-turn layer: turning while the encoder is held fires `…RotateLeftSmooth` / `…RotateRightSmooth` instead of the Ratchet ones, and the press is then consumed (the plain tap actions in `BTTActionsToExecute` do not run on release). This requires firmware that reports encoder releases; otherwise the press is treated as a plain tap. See the Floating Menu reference tool for full documentation.

#### Macro Pad Strip Swipes (menu / submenu level)[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#macro-pad-strip-swipes-menu--submenu-level "Direct link to Macro Pad Strip Swipes (menu / submenu level)")

Menus (767) and submenus (774) that drive a macro pad with an LCD touch strip (Stream Deck+, Mirabox/AJAZZ) can carry actions for strip swipes. They are assigned to the container, not to an item, because the strip is shared by everything on it:

| JSON Key | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `BTTActionCategorySwipeLeft` | Swipe left on the touch strip |
| `BTTActionCategorySwipeRight` | Swipe right on the touch strip |

A direction with actions assigned does NOT page the pad's keys anymore — the actions replace paging for that direction. Directions without actions keep the default swipe-to-page behavior, and paging always stays reachable through the automatic prev/next chevrons, navigation items, and the "Macro Pad: Next / Previous Page" predefined actions. While a submenu is open on the pad, the swipe actions of that submenu apply.

#### Per-Item Triggers (`BTTMenuItemTriggers`)[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#per-item-triggers-bttmenuitemtriggers "Direct link to per-item-triggers-bttmenuitemtriggers")

Menu items (773) and submenus (774) can carry child triggers (keyboard shortcut, key sequence, trackpad, magic mouse or normal mouse triggers) that execute the item like a click. They are stored in the item's `BTTMenuItemTriggers` array and marked with `BTTActionCategory: 50`. `BTTMenuTriggerScope` controls when they are active: 0/omitted = while the menu is focused or hovered (default), 1 = only focused, 2 = only hovered, 4 = always while visible. They usually carry predefined action 603 ("Trigger Specific Floating Menu Item"), which executes the parent item's assigned actions. Menus (767) themselves can also carry trigger children of any supported type with `BTTMenuTriggerScope` 8 (always active, even while hidden) and predefined action 388/386/387 (Toggle/Show/Hide Floating Menu) - a global shortcut for the menu. The variable `focused_floating_menu_identifier` (alongside `hovered_floating_menu_identifier` and `visible_floating_menu_identifiers`) is available for advanced conditions.

### 13\. MIDI[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#13-midi "Direct link to 13. MIDI")

**BTTTriggerClass**: `"BTTTriggerTypeMIDI"`

The `BTTTriggerType` for MIDI triggers is `5000 + the MIKMIDI command type value`, e.g.:

*   `5143` - Note Off (0x8F)
*   `5159` - Note On (0x9F)
*   `5175` - Polyphonic Key Pressure (0xAF)
*   `5191` - Control Change (0xBF)
*   `5207` - Program Change (0xCF)
*   `5239` - Pitch Bend (0xEF)

| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BTTMidiTriggerDeviceName` | String | Device name to match, `"*"` = any device (inside `BTTTriggerConfig`) |

Note: the note/controller number a MIDI trigger listens to can currently not be set via JSON - record it via the MIDI trigger configuration UI in BTT ("MIDI learn"). Learned triggers additionally round-trip the keys `BTTMidiTriggerIfVelocity`, `BTTMidiTriggerValue`, `BTTMidiActiveNotes`, `BTTMidiRepeatDelay` and `BTTMidiRepeatRate`.

    {  "BTTTriggerType": 5159,  "BTTTriggerClass": "BTTTriggerTypeMIDI",  "BTTTriggerConfig": {    "BTTMidiTriggerDeviceName": "*"  },  "BTTActionsToExecute": [{    "BTTPredefinedActionType": 45  }]}

Special Configurations[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#special-configurations "Direct link to Special Configurations")

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Colors[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#colors "Direct link to Colors")

Colors are specified as comma-separated RGBA values:

    "255, 255, 255, 255" = White (fully opaque)"0, 0, 0, 255" = Black (fully opaque)"255, 0, 0, 128" = Red (50% transparent)

### Modifier Keys[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#modifier-keys "Direct link to Modifier Keys")

Modifier keys use bitwise flags:

*   Command: `1048576`
*   Option: `524288`
*   Control: `262144`
*   Shift: `131072`
*   Function (fn): `8388608`

Combine with bitwise OR:

*   Command+Shift: `1048576 | 131072 = 1179648`

### Icons[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#icons "Direct link to Icons")

Icons can be specified as:

1.  Base64 encoded image data in `BTTIconData`
2.  SF Symbol names in `BTTTouchBarItemSFSymbolDefaultIcon`
3.  File paths for Stream Deck icons

### Conditions[​](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/json/trigger-definitions#conditions "Direct link to Conditions")

Advanced conditions use `BTTTriggerConditionsData` with base64 encoded predicates.
